items.title: A Family-Friendly Retreat in the Heart of Nature at Dusun Bonda
items.content:
Credit to Dusun Bonda

Located in the serene Hulu Tamu, Batang Kali, and only an hour's drive from Kuala Lumpur, Dusun Bonda provides the ideal respite from the bustle of the city and has been open since 2018. 

Enjoy the best of both worlds at Dusun Bonda, a tranquil family getaway encircled by a verdant 2.1-acre apple orchard. They provide a serene setting with kid-friendly amenities, a swimming pool, a man-made waterfall, and a peaceful river, all surrounded by nature, to make sure you and your loved ones enjoy an experience they won't soon forget. 

Credit to Dusun Bonda





Dusun Bonda was created as a way to share the warmth and coziness of early childhood memories with others. Inspired by a love for the outdoors and a desire to establish a family haven, the name 'Dusun' means orchard, while 'Bonda' means mother, symbolizing the creation of lasting family memories and nurturing bonds. The goal is to provide families with a place to relax, reconnect, and create cherished moments together.



Location: Lot 2121 (2996) Jalan Ulu Tamu, Kampung Orang Asli Gurney, Ulu Tamu, 44300 Batang Kali, Selangor Darul Ehsan, Malaysia.















Accommodation Options

Credit to Dusun Bonda


With its 18 units, Dusun Bonda can accommodate up to 90 adults or 108 adults with children under the age of 12. Every room has a gazebo and private bathroom, making it the ideal spot to eat, unwind or have a cookout. The three categories of accommodation that are available are as follows:

1. Glam 4 Bell Tent

  • Features: 2 queen mattresses
  • Capacity: Up to 4 adults OR 4 adults & 1 child under 12 years old
  • Units Available: 8
2. Glam 5 Premium Bell Tent

  • Features: 3 queen mattresses
  • Capacity: Up to 6 adults OR 6 adults & 1 child under 12 years old
  • Units Available: 8
3. Studio Villa

  • Features: Queen bunk bed and a single pull-out bed
  • Capacity: Up to 5 adults OR 5 adults & 1 child under 12 years old
  • Units Available: 2


Start your day with a complimentary breakfast, and for lunch and dinner, they offer a variety of options to suit your preferences. Indulge in a delicious BBQ dinner prepared by them, complete with a BBQ pit, for just RM25 per person. If you prefer a more hands-on experience, you can rent a BBQ pit for RM18 per night and bring your own food, with all the necessary utensils provided. Alternatively, you can have food delivered directly to Dusun Bonda via GRAB or take advantage of their shared kitchen to cook your own meals with the ingredients you bring. For those who want to explore, nearby towns offer a range of local dining spots to discover. Whatever your choice, they will make sure your meals are as delightful as your stay.

  
Family-Friendly Activities

Swimming Pool
  • Featuring a man-made waterfall, an adult pool with a water bucket, a kids’ pool, and a play pool with a slide.
Bamboo Water Rafting
  • A fun and exciting adventure on the river.
River Swim & Play
  • Enjoy the natural beauty of the Ulu Tamu River, just a short walk from your accommodation.
Mini River Tubing
  • Rent a tube for just RM8 per piece during your 2D1N stay.
Bonfire
  • Cozy up for a bonfire session under the stars, perfect for storytelling and marshmallow roasting. Available nightly at 9:00 pm (weather permitting).
Jungle Trekking
  • Explore the lush jungle with a guided trek to a waterfall. Available upon request.


Facilities

Shared Kitchen
  • 3 shared kitchens for the glamping units, as well as a private kitchen for studio villas.
Riverside Tamu Hall
  • An open-space hall ideal for group activities and events.
Viewing Deck
  • Relax and take in the panoramic views, a perfect spot for photography.
Prayer Room
  • A dedicated prayer space for Muslim guests, with the option to pray in individual units.
Vending Machine
  • A selection of snacks and beverages for your convenience.
Wi-Fi
  • Stay connected with free Wi-Fi via Starlink, available in all units. CelcomDigi network is also stable in the area.


Recreational Areas

Hammocks
  • Several hammocks are available for you to unwind and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

Kids Playground
  • A playground with slides and other fun structures for the little ones to enjoy.

DIY Swing
  • A fun swing for both adults and children.


Dusun Bonda is the ideal destination for families seeking a peaceful nature retreat. Whether you're looking to relax by the river, enjoy a BBQ under the stars, or explore the great outdoors, they do have something for everyone. Located on Level 2 of The Curve, Hauntu draws inspiration from Malaysia’s rich tapestry of cultural narratives. 

As you navigate the haunted corridors, you will encounter supernatural art forms such as Mak Yong, Kuda Kepang, and Wayang Kulit, which elevate the horror experience into an exploration of Malaysia’s vibrant traditions.

Will you take the risk and engage with the spirits, or will you find a way to escape? 

Each visit to Hauntu promises spine-tingling unpredictability, keeping your adrenaline levels high.

items.title: SUNGEI WANG PLAZA: A CULINARY REVIVAL IN THE HEART OF KUALA LUMPUR
items.content:
Credit by Sungei Wang Plaza

Sungei Wang Plaza, a landmark in Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur, has proudly served as the longest-running shopping centre since its opening in 1977. 

With around 800,000 square feet of retail space, it has become a prime destination for both locals and tourists. 

Many visitors echo the sentiment, “If you haven’t been to Sungei Wang Plaza, you haven’t been to Kuala Lumpur.” 

The mall features a wide range of services and products, from optical services and boutique fashion to beauty salons and entertainment options, including the Mega Star Arena, which accommodates 5000 people. 

Creddit by Sungei Wang Plaza

One of the most beloved attractions is the food court on the fourth floor, a nostalgic spot where authentic local flavors come to life. 

This food court has long been a haven for busy office workers and tourists in search of traditional dishes that evoke comfort and warmth. 

In a commitment to enhance its culinary offerings, Sungei Wang Plaza has undertaken a significant renovation of its food court.

The new “Wang Food Court” aims to elevate the dining experience by improving the ambience and diversity of food options available. 


Credit by Sungei Wang Plaza

The revitalized food court retains the essence of its past life while providing a more comfortable atmosphere. 

It also features a small performance stage to enliven the space. 

With its exquisite new decor, and creative murals celebrating Malaysia’s rich food culture, the updated space promises to engage diners in a sensory experience that melds visual beauty with culinary enjoyment. 

“Wang Food Court” offers an exciting combination of traditional and contemporary cuisines, featuring classic Hainanese Chicken Rice, noodle soups and vegetarian options as well as a range of international delights from various Asian cuisines including Thai, Vietnamese, Korean and Sichuan dishes. 

With over 30 stalls, and 1000 flavor options, it caters to diverse palates, appealing to food lovers of all ages. 

The grand opening ceremony for “Wang Food Court” was on 21 January 2025, complete with cultural festivities such as lion dances and a Yee Sang Tossing Ceremony. 


Credit by Sungei Wang Plaza

To celebrate, a series of engaging activities took place, including a lucky draw at the food court where visitors could win souvenirs or shopping vouchers. 

With modern neon lighting and an industrial design aesthetic, the newly renovated food court is set to become a must-visit location in Bukit Bintang, blending contemporary trends with Malaysian cultural themes. 

As it approaches its 50th anniversary, Sungei Wang Plaza continues to innovate, ensuring a vibrant experience for both new and returning visitors.

items.title: AN OVERVIEW OF MEDICAL TOURISM IN MALAYSIA
items.content:
Medical tourism refers to the dynamic practice of traveling to another country for medical treatment, healthcare services, or wellness procedures. 

This growing phenomenon emerges from individuals' desire to find high-quality healthcare options at more affordable prices than those offered in their home countries. 

Medical tourists often seek a variety of treatments, including elective surgeries, cosmetic procedures, dental care, fertility treatments, and comprehensive health screenings. 

The allure of medical tourism goes beyond mere cost savings; it encompasses access to advanced medical technologies, highly skilled professionals, and the unique opportunity to combine treatment with the exploration of new cultures and leisure experiences in foreign destinations.


Malaysia stands out as a prominent and sought-after destination for medical tourism, enticing patients from around the globe with its unique blend of affordability, exceptional healthcare quality, and rich cultural heritage. 

The cost of medical treatments in Malaysia can be significantly lower than in many Western countries, making it an irresistible option for those desiring quality care without the immense financial burden.

The spectrum of medical services available in Malaysia is both comprehensive and impressive. 

Patients can access an array of treatments that may address multiple health needs in a single trip, ranging from cosmetic surgery and dental care to complex medical procedures. 

This extensive variety ensures that individuals benefit from the latest medical technologies and innovative practices without compromising quality.


Cosmetic and Aesthetic Procedures 

Malaysia has rapidly emerged as a hotspot for cosmetic surgery, celebrated for its affordability and high standards of care. 

Popular procedures such as breast augmentation, liposuction, and facelifts attract many seeking transformative changes. 

Many esteemed clinics leverage cutting-edge techniques, promising minimal downtime and optimal results. 

The prospect of achieving one’s desired appearance with less pain and quicker recovery is nothing short of a dream come true. 

Coupled with the chance to recuperate in a serene and beautiful environment, the entire experience becomes a remarkable journey of self-enhancement.

 

Dental Tourism 

Malaysia's dental care services are experiencing rapid growth and recognition, attracting both local and international patients. 

Many advanced dental clinics offer a comprehensive range of procedures, from routine check-ups to cutting-edge cosmetic dentistry, including veneers, teeth whitening, and orthodontics. 

These facilities prioritize patient comfort and high-quality care, making Malaysia an increasingly popular destination for effective and affordable dental treatments. 

As a result, individuals seeking revitalized smiles and improved oral health are drawn to the country.



Fertility Treatments 

For couples navigating the complexities of fertility, Malaysia has become a notable destination, offering a wide array of treatments such as in-vitro fertilization (IVF). 

Numerous clinics boast high success rates and provide invaluable services, including egg freezing, sperm banking, and genetic testing. 

Additionally, an often-overlooked treatment gaining traction is fertility massage. 

Certified therapists trained in this technique deliver therapeutic massages that enhance circulation and address hormonal imbalances, ultimately fostering a supportive environment for natural fertility enhancement.


Health Screening Packages 

The emphasis on preventive healthcare in Malaysia is becoming increasingly robust, with numerous hospitals offering comprehensive health screening packages that encompass a wide range of tests, including blood tests, imaging studies, and expert consultations. 

These healthcare facilities provide tailored screening options that assess various aspects of health, including metabolic functions, chronic disease risk, and overall wellness. 

Such services not only attract Malaysian citizens but also a significant number of tourists and expatriates seeking high-quality healthcare at competitive prices. 

This focus on preventive services enhances Malaysia's reputation as a leading destination for comprehensive health assessments, ultimately improving public health outcomes and solidifying the country’s status in the medical tourism sector.



Medical tourism in Malaysia is thriving, propelled by the synergy of high-quality healthcare, cost-effective treatments, and a captivating cultural experience. 

With healthcare facilities continually evolving and enhancing their offerings, Malaysia’s reputation as a premier medical tourism destination is poised for further growth. 

Meanwhile, other countries aspiring to tap into this lucrative market can learn from effective advertising strategies to create awareness and entice prospective medical travelers. 

By seamlessly integrating healthcare with leisure, these nations can position themselves as alluring alternatives for patients seeking treatment abroad.

items.title: LIPOSUCTION AT SJ CLINICAL AESTHETICS
items.content:
Credit to SJ Clinical Aesthetics

What Do You Need to Know?

Liposuction is a minimally invasive cosmetic procedure that removes stubborn fat deposits, reshaping body areas like the abdomen, thighs, and arms.

For medical tourists, undergoing liposuction abroad provides access to world-class medical expertise at a fraction of the cost. 

Credit to SJ Clinical Aesthetics


How Does Liposuction Work?

During the procedure, a surgeon makes small incisions and inserts a thin tube (cannula) to suction out fat.

It’s usually done under general anaesthesia; patients need a few weeks to recover. Compression garments help reduce swelling and improve skin contouring.


Types of Liposuction Available

  • Mini Liposuction: Targets small fat pockets for a toned look, ideal for fit individuals.

  • Large Volume Liposuction: Removes more fat in a single session, beneficial for plus-size patients.

  • Combination Procedures: Often paired with tummy tucks, facelifts, or breast augmentation for enhanced results.


Credit to SJ Clinical Aesthetics

Post-Surgery Expectations

Swelling and bruising are common, but full results appear in a few months. Patients should wear compression garments for six weeks and follow post-op care guidelines to avoid complications.


Credit to SJ Clinical Aesthetics

Benefits and Considerations

Liposuction offers long-lasting body contouring, as fat cells don’t regenerate in adulthood.

However, skin elasticity, post-op care, and the surgeon’s expertise play important roles in the outcome.

  • Effective Fat Reduction - targets specific areas to remove fat

  • Boost in Confidence - achieve smaller, more contoured appearance

  • Cost-Effective - medical tourism destinations often offer liposuction at 50% lower prices than Western countries


Credit to SJ Clinical Aesthetics

If you’re considering liposuction in Malaysia, consult Dr Soma Plastic Surgery, a certified and experienced surgeon to ensure safe and satisfactory results.

items.title: NO MORE KELOIDS WITH SJ CLINICAL AESTHETICS
items.content:
Got keloids? 

It's annoying? 

Do you want your healthy-looking skin again?

SJ Clinical Aesthetics has your back! 

Credit to SJ Clinical 

Effective Keloid Treatments: Solutions for Raised Scars

Keloids are raised, thickened scars that form when the skin heals excessively after an injury. 

Unlike regular scars, they can continue to grow, becoming larger and more noticeable. 

While they aren’t harmful, they can be uncomfortable and affect your appearance, they can also cause discomfort like itching. 

Thankfully, there are various treatments available to help reduce or eliminate keloids. 

Credit to SJ Clinical 

How Keloids Happen

Keloids usually occur when the body produces too much collagen during the healing process of a wound.

Normally, when the skin is injured, the body produces collagen to repair the tissue. 

However, in people prone to keloids, the body produces excess collagen, leading to an overgrowth of scar tissue. 

This overgrowth can extend beyond the original wound, forming a keloid. 

Factors such as genetics, skin type, and the location of the injury can increase the risk of keloid formation.

Credit to SJ Clinical 

Common Keloid Treatments

1. Wound Care: Proper wound care is crucial to prevent keloids from forming in the first place. 

Keeping wounds clean and well-moisturized can minimise the chances of excessive scar tissue developing. 

Generally, if a wound heals within three weeks then the chances of keloid developing is less.

2. Corticosteroid Creams and Injections: Corticosteroid treatments, either in cream form or via injections, are commonly used to flatten keloids and reduce inflammation. 

Injections are particularly effective for larger keloids.

3. Laser Treatment: Laser therapy targets the excess collagen in the keloid, helping to flatten it and reduce redness or discolouration. 

It’s a highly effective way to smooth out raised scars and to decolourise reddish scars.

4. Radiation Therapy: In severe cases, low-dose radiation can be used after surgical removal to prevent the keloid from returning. 

It's highly effective and common in Japan.

5. Surgical Removal: Surgical excision can remove larger keloids, but there’s a risk the keloid may grow back. 

Often, surgery is combined with other treatments, such as steroid injections, silicone gel sheets and radiation therapy to minimize recurrence.

Why Consult Dr. Soma from SJ Clinical?

Credit to SJ Clinical 

At SJ Clinical, Dr. Soma offers expert solutions for keloid treatment. 

With personalized care, Dr. Soma uses advanced treatments to help reduce the size and appearance of keloids. 

If you’re struggling with keloids, Dr. Soma can recommend the best treatment plan tailored to your needs, ensuring the best possible results for smoother, healthier skin. 

Dr Soma has 30 years of experience in keloid and scar management. 

Get rid of your keloids today!

items.title: LET'S APPRECIATE ART AT UR-MU
items.content:
Ur-Mu isn't your typical museum - it's a creative playground in the heart of the city!

Perfect for the fast-paced generation, Ur-Mu redefines how we experience art. 

No need to spend hours deciphering - it's all about connecting instantly with pieces that spark curiosity and imagination. 

Credit to Ur-Mu


Every artwork has a unique meaning but the beauty lies in your interpretation. 

Ur-Mu is more than just a gallery; it's proof that "Art is the soul of the vibrant city," offering a space to pause, reflect, and be inspired. 

Ur-Mu has 10 themed gallery spaces: 

Sens-Asia: A journey to the rich and diverse cultures of Asia. 

This gallery reflects the unique and varied experiences that make the region so captivating, showcasing the beauty of tradition, history and vibrant cultural diversity. 

Credit to Ur-Mu

People: Step into the heart of human emotion with stunning portraits that capture the essence of individual stories. 

Each piece expresses feelings and experiences through the eyes of the artist, inviting you to connect with the people behind the art. 

Kampung Kita: Discover the soul of traditional village life in Asia. 

Explore the patterns, heritage and stories that shape rural communities, offering a window into the simple yet profound ways of life that define this region. 

Power Play: Art as expression - this gallery delves into the world of socio-political themes, giving artists a platform to voice their views and provoke thought.  

Expect bold and impactful pieces that challenge perspectives on power, society and change.

Credit to Ur-Mu

Raksasa (Monster): Let your imagination run wild!

Folklore and myth come to life, creatures that have haunted our imaginations for generations.

It's a space where the mythical becomes reality.

Credit to Ur-Mu

Superheroes: Celebrate the heroes who've left an indelible mark on society.

This honours the figures who have shaped the world through their courage, resilience and contributions. 

Framing Modernity: Experience the evolution of modernity through the eyes of visionary artists and explore how the region has transformed, reflecting the fast-changing pace of society and the shifting landscape of contemporary life.

Structure: Admire the beauty of the urban landscape and architectural wonders. 

Made's Garden: Enter a world of whimsical imagination where the bizarre and fantastical thrive. 

Made's Garden is a space where creativity blooms in unexpected forms, offering a glimpse into the enchanting world of flora and fauna. 

Credit to Ur-Mu

Sculpture Lounge: Calling all sculpture enthusiasts! 

This relaxed and inviting space celebrates the timeless beauty of sculpture, offering a comfortable setting to admire masterpieces and explore the art of three-dimensional expressions. 

Whether you're an art enthusiast or simply curious about the creative pulse of Kuala Lumpur, Ur-Mu promises a captivating journey into the world of contemporary art and culture. 

Credit to Ur-Mu

Ready to immerse yourself in the world of art and creativity? 

Visit Ur-Mu and let your imagination run wild! 

Discover these galleries and find your connection with art.

items.title: DISCOVER THE TOP SIGNATURE DISHES AT HOCK KEE KOPITIAM!
items.content:
Credit to BBCC Development 

Calling all food lovers! If you haven’t yet experienced the magic of Hock Kee Kopitiam, then it’s time to indulge in the flavors that have earned this local favorite its reputation. 

Known for its blend of traditional recipes and contemporary twists, Hock Kee Kopitiam serves up dishes that satisfy every craving, from savory mains to delicious desserts. 

Whether you’re a long-time fan or a first-time visitor, these top signature dishes are sure to make your visit unforgettable.

Let’s dive into the must-try dishes at Hock Kee Kopitiam, where every bite is crafted with love and the finest ingredients!

Credit to BBCC Development

Hock Kee Charcoal Polo Bun

A modern twist on a local classic! The Hock Kee Charcoal Polo Bun features a slightly smoky, crispy top with soft, fluffy bread inside. 

Perfect for breakfast or a mid-day snack, this bun is filled with a delightful blend of flavors and textures.

Sambal Egg Cucumber Toast

Looking for something with a kick? The Sambal Egg Cucumber Toast is a bold and flavorful combination of creamy egg, tangy sambal, and fresh cucumber, all sandwiched between toasted bread.

It’s a must-try for those who love a little heat in their meal!

Golden Pumpkin Kaya Toast

This sweet treat brings together the rich flavors of golden pumpkin and smooth kaya (coconut jam), creating a comforting and satisfying toast. 

Perfect for those who enjoy a mix of sweetness with a savory edge.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Thai Tofu

Light, crisp, and packed with flavor, the Thai Tofu is deep-fried to golden perfection and served with a zesty sauce that’s both refreshing and savory. 

This dish is ideal for those seeking a delicious vegetarian option.

Kuih Jagung

A delightful and comforting local snack, Kuih Jagung is made with sweet corn and coconut, resulting in a soft, aromatic treat that's sure to please. 

Perfect as a quick bite or paired with your favorite drink.

Kuih Talam

This two-layered, vibrant kuih is a perfect balance of savory and sweet. 

Kuih Talam is made from pandan and coconut layers, creating a smooth texture that will melt in your mouth with every bite.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Nasi Lemak Banjir

A signature dish that’s hard to beat, the Nasi Lemak Banjir features fluffy coconut rice topped with spicy sambal, crispy fried chicken, and all the traditional fixings. 

The rich flavors and satisfying portions make it an all-time favorite.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Mee Siam with Fried Chicken Meat

A perfect combination of sweet, sour, and savory, the Mee Siam with Fried Chicken Meat is a hearty dish featuring delicate noodles in a tangy gravy, topped with crispy fried chicken. 

It’s a fusion of flavors that’s both unique and comforting.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Hock Kee Signature Laksa

A dish that captures the essence of the region’s vibrant flavors, the Hock Kee Signature Laksa combines a rich, creamy broth with chewy noodles and a variety of fresh toppings. 

It’s a hearty and satisfying meal you’ll want to savor every time.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Steamed Chicken Rice

A classic favorite, the Steamed Chicken Rice is perfectly tender chicken served with fragrant rice and accompanied by spicy chili sauce. 

It's simple yet packed with flavor, making it a timeless dish loved by many.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Signature Lontong with Chicken Meat

A rich, hearty dish, Signature Lontong with Chicken Meat features compressed rice cakes in a coconut broth, served with tender chicken and a variety of vegetables. 

This dish is the epitome of comfort food, perfect for any time of day.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Shredded Chicken Congee with Century Egg

Warm and nourishing, the Shredded Chicken Congee with Century Egg offers a comforting bowl of rice porridge, loaded with tender chicken and the distinct flavor of century egg. 

It's the perfect dish for those seeking a soothing, flavorful meal.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Satay Fried Kuey Teow

A creative twist on a classic, the Satay Fried Kuey Teow combines the smoky flavors of satay with stir-fried flat noodles. 

It’s a delightful dish that brings together savory, spicy, and aromatic flavors in every bite.

Credit to BBCC Development 

Hock Kee Big Breakfast

For those who love a hearty, all-in-one meal, the Hock Kee Big Breakfast offers a delicious spread of local breakfast favorites, from eggs to toast to a variety of sides. 

It’s the ultimate choice for a fulfilling start to your day!

Refreshing Drinks to Pair with Your Meal

Credit to BBCC Development 

No meal is complete without the perfect drink to complement the flavors. 

At Hock Kee Kopitiam, we offer a selection of refreshing beverages that will quench your thirst and enhance your dining experience:

  • Hor Ka Sai: A traditional herbal drink with a refreshing, slightly bitter taste, perfect for balancing the richness of your meal.
  • Hock Kee Lemongrass Lemon Tea: A zesty, refreshing blend of lemongrass and lemon tea that’s both soothing and invigorating.
  • 3-Layer Tea: This beautiful drink features three distinct layers of tea, giving you a visually stunning and deliciously unique taste experience.

Indulgent Desserts

Credit to BBCC Development 

Save room for dessert! End your meal on a sweet note with one of our signature tarts:
  • Golden Summer Egg Tart: A silky, smooth custard filling encased in a flaky pastry, it’s a simple yet decadent dessert.
  • Milky Sea Salt Egg Tart: A twist on the classic, this tart has a hint of sea salt that elevates the sweetness of the custard filling for a delightful balance.
  • Signature Sunshine Egg Tart: Light, airy, and bursting with flavor, this egg tart is the perfect way to satisfy your sweet tooth.

Come Experience the Flavors of Hock Kee Kopitiam!

From savory mains to irresistible desserts, Hock Kee Kopitiam offers an array of delicious dishes that showcase the best of local and regional flavors. 

Whether you’re craving something hearty, light, or sweet, you’ll find it all here. 

Bring your friends and family, and don’t forget to tag us in your foodie photos—we love seeing your culinary adventures!

Come on over and discover the flavors that make Hock Kee Kopitiam a top local eatery! 📸✨

items.title: CENGILD G.I. MEDICAL CENTRE’S CSR INITIATIVE: A HEARTFELT MAKEOVER OF SMK SERI PANTAI’S MEDICAL ROOM
items.content:
Credits to Cengild G.I Medical Center

On Friday, 15th November 2024, Cengild G.I. Medical Centre organised a meaningful Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) event at Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Seri Pantai (SMK Seri Pantai).

The initiative aimed to upgrade and makeover the school’s Bilik Kesihatan (medical room) to ensure it serves the students more effectively.

The event, held from 8:00 AM to 12:30 PM, saw enthusiastic participation from Cengild staff and students from Ahli Bulan Sabit Merah Malaysia, SMK Seri Pantai.

Credits to Cengild G.I Medical Center

KICKING OFF WITH ENERGY AND TEAM SPIRIT

The day began with an invigorating aerobic session led by Cengild’s very own physiotherapist, Augustin.

The upbeat session set the tone for the day, bringing together participants in high spirits and ready to tackle the tasks ahead.

The aerobic activity not only served as a warm-up but also highlighted the importance of physical health and teamwork.

Credits to Cengild G.I Medical Center

REVITALISING THE MEDICAL ROOM 

After the much-needed warm-up, everyone rolled up their sleeves and got to work.


The makeover began with a thorough deep cleaning of the Bilik Kesihatan.


From wiping down surfaces and scrubbing the floors to sweeping and mopping, every corner of the room was cleaned to perfection.


The collaborative effort was a heartwarming sight, with Cengild staff and students working side by side.


This was followed by the installation of new items contributed by Cengild G.I. Medical Centre, which would greatly enhance the functionality and accessibility of the room.

Credits to Cengild G.I Medical Center

CONTRIBUTIONS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE 

Cengild’s generous donations included a comprehensive range of items tailored to improve the Bilik Kesihatan’s utility. 


The contributions were: 


1. Signage for "Bilik Kesihatan" – Ensuring clear identification of the space. 

2. Wheelchairs (x2) – Enhancing mobility support. 

3. Stretcher – For emergency medical situations. 

4. Mobile trolley – To organize and transport medical items efficiently.

5. Snellen chart – For proper eye screenings. 

6. Weighing and height scales – Essential for health assessments. 

7. Blinds (x9) – To provide privacy and comfort. 

8. First aid kit – Stocked with iodine, gauze, and sprays for sports events. 

9. Portable ramp – Improving accessibility for wheelchair access. 

10.Dustbins (x4) – Promoting cleanliness and waste management. 

11.Bedsheets (x3) – For a hygienic resting area. 

12.Painting and fixing the sink's pipe leakage – Enhancing aesthetics and functionality.

13.Fridge – To store medical ice packs and supplies.


In addition, health screening vouchers were distributed to teachers as a token of gratitude for their dedication to shaping young minds. 


This gesture highlighted Cengild’s recognition of educators’ health and well-being as vital to the community's strength.


Credits to Cengild G.I Medical Center

MAKING A LASTING IMPACT 

The event culminated in smiles and a sense of accomplishment.


The upgraded Bilik Kesihatan now stands as a testament to Cengild’s commitment to supporting the community and improving public health facilities. 


Students and teachers at SMK Seri Pantai expressed their heartfelt gratitude, emphasizing how the improved room will significantly benefit their school community.

Credits to Cengild G.I Medical Center

LOOKING AHEAD 

This CSR event exemplifies how small acts of kindness can create a ripple effect of positive change. 


Cengild G.I. Medical Centre remains dedicated to giving back to the community, inspiring others to contribute in their own ways to make a difference. 


By uplifting SMK Seri Pantai’s Bilik Kesihatan, Cengild not only provided essential resources but also fostered a spirit of care and collaboration—a true hallmark of meaningful community service.

Whether you’re here for a quick bite or planning to linger over a coffee and dessert, Croutons Café offers the ideal setting for every occasion.

items.title: CENGILD G. I. MEDICAL CENTRE - BEYOND DIET: EMPOWERING HEALTH WITH BARIATRIC SURGERY
items.content:
Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

On September 6th and 7th, 2024, Cengild G.I. Medical Centre organised a highly impactful health talk in Brunei Darussalam, titled "BEYOND Diet." 

Held at Mulia Hotel and Panaga Club, the event featured Dr. Mustafa Taher, a renowned Consultant Upper GI & Bariatric Surgeon and four-time recipient of the Best Bariatric Surgeon in the Asia Pacific award. 

Dr. Mustafa shared crucial insights on obesity and its management, offering valuable information on how to effectively address the condition and reduce associated health risks.

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

Dr. Mustafa’s sessions emphasized the severe health risks associated with obesity, including diabetes, hypertension, sleep apnea, and gastric issues. 

He stressed that obesity is not merely a cosmetic concern but a serious medical condition that requires comprehensive intervention. 

While bariatric surgery is a crucial tool for patients struggling with significant weight loss—particularly when traditional diet and exercise methods fall short—Dr. Mustafa emphasized that surgery alone is not enough. 

A balanced diet and regular exercise remain fundamental in both preventing and managing obesity. Incorporating these lifestyle changes, along with medical interventions like bariatric surgery, forms a long-term weight management plan that improves overall health and reduces the risks linked to obesity.

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

Dr. Mustafa also appeared on the live TV show "Rampai Pagi" on Radio Televisyen Brunei, where he discussed the increasing prevalence of health conditions such as hypertension, high cholesterol, and diabetes. 

He highlighted how lifestyle changes, particularly in reducing obesity-related health risks, can play a crucial role in managing these conditions.

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

Overall, the two-day event was a success, showcasing Cengild’s commitment to educating the community about obesity and the importance of adopting healthier lifestyles. 

While the focus was on managing obesity through proper nutrition and regular exercise, Dr. Mustafa highlighted that bariatric surgery can be an option for individuals who struggle to lose weight and need to mitigate high-risk health issues. 

The event provided a fantastic opportunity for participants to learn about various strategies for better health and connect with others on similar journeys.

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

Dr. Mustafa Taher is a highly respected Consultant Upper GI & Bariatric Surgeon, widely recognised for his expertise in bariatric surgery. 

A native of Iraq, he obtained his medical degree from the College of Medicine, University of Baghdad, followed by a Master’s in General Surgery from Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia (UKM). 

He further honed his expertise through an Upper Gastroenterology and Bariatric Fellowship at UKM. 

Dr. Mustafa has been residing and practicing in Malaysia for over 17 years, contributing significantly to the advancement of bariatric care in the region.

Dr. Mustafa has been honoured as the Best Bariatric Surgeon in the Asia Pacific for four consecutive years, underscoring his surgical excellence, commitment to innovation, and dedication to patient care. 

Currently serving as a Consultant Surgeon at Cengild G.I. Medical Centre in Bangsar, he has successfully performed more than 2,000 bariatric surgeries, helping numerous patients address obesity and associated health conditions such as diabetes, sleep apnoea, and hypertension.

Dr. Mustafa’s professional achievements are complemented by his deep commitment to improving patient outcomes and enhancing their overall quality of life, making him a leading figure in the field of bariatric surgery.

items.title: ACHIEVE CLEAR, FLAWLESS SKIN WITH BELECO CLINIC'S 13-STEP ACNE TREATMENT GUIDE IN KUALA LUMPUR
items.content:
Credits to Beleco Clinic

Are you currently exploring Kuala Lumpur and looking to achieve clearer skin for that perfect OOTD during your travels?

Let’s explore Beleco Clinic’s comprehensive 13-step guide to help you tackle acne and achieve flawless skin!

Beleco Clinic, with locations in Petaling Jaya and Puchong, specializes in acne treatments. 

Their expert team will help you determine if you belong to the acne-prone category and offer personalized solutions.

Before diving into acne treatment, it's important to understand what triggers these breakouts. 

Acne typically has two main causes: hormonal and non-hormonal. 

Hormonal acne is often the result of imbalances in your body's hormones, which can be influenced by puberty, stress, and other factors. 

Non-hormonal acne, on the other hand, stems from issues like excess oil production, bacteria buildup, dead skin cells, or even hair care products.

Credits to Beleco Clinic

Recognizing the root cause of your acne is key to finding the right treatment. 

Now, let’s move on to the effective strategies in Beleco Clinic's guide:

1. Choose a Gentle Cleanser

Ditch harsh products and opt for a mild, non-abrasive cleanser that clears away oil without stripping your skin. Look for ingredients like salicylic acid, which helps fight acne.

2. Incorporate Exfoliation

Regular exfoliation helps remove dead skin cells and unclog pores. It should be a regular part of your routine to prevent acne flare-ups.

3. Stay Hydrated

Water is your skin's best friend. Drink at least eight glasses daily to help your skin stay hydrated and combat acne-causing bacteria.

4. Avoid Popping Pimples

It’s tempting, but popping pimples can lead to scars and more breakouts. It’s best to let them heal naturally.

5. If You Must, Pop Responsibly

If you can’t resist, wait until the pimple is ready, cleanse your hands and skin, use a warm compress, and gently press with a cotton pad.

6. Use Spot Treatments

For stubborn spots, apply treatments with active ingredients like salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide, or tea tree oil.

7. Moisturise

Don’t skip this step! Use a light, oil-free moisturiser to keep your skin hydrated and prevent future breakouts.

8. Eat a Healthy Diet

Include foods rich in antioxidants, like berries, and omega-3s, like salmon, to support clear, healthy skin.

9. Prioritise Cleanliness

Regularly wash your pillowcases, towels, and clean your phone screen. These can harbor bacteria that contribute to breakouts.

10. Choose Non-Comedogenic Products

Always check labels for non-pore-clogging ingredients. Some products may trigger acne, so be mindful of what you apply.

11. Avoid Overwashing

Excessive washing or scrubbing can irritate your skin. Cleansing twice a day is enough to maintain balance.

12. Select Oil-Free Products

Stick to oil-free or non-pore-clogging products, and remember that not all oils are bad—tea tree oil can actually be helpful.

13. Keep Hair Away From Your Face

Hair can transfer oils to your skin, so try to keep it off your face, especially when following your skincare routine.

Credits to Beleco Clinic

These straightforward tips can serve as a great starting point in your journey to clearer skin. 

As an Authorized LCP-Certified Provider aesthetic clinic, Beleco Clinic is committed to helping you overcome any insecurities and achieve the physical appearance you desire.

Don’t hesitate to visit Beleco Clinic for expert acne treatment tailored just for you!

items.title: MALAYSIAN DRIVING GUIDE WITH AVIS CAR RENTAL
items.content:
Credits to Avis Car Rental

Driving in Malaysia is a fantastic way to explore the country’s sights and attractions. 

If you’re searching for a reliable car rental service in Kuala Lumpur, Avis Car Rental offers a variety of vehicles to ensure a smooth and enjoyable travel experience.

Established in Malaysia in 1972, Avis has grown to operate 18 rental locations and two site offices nationwide. 

Credits to Avis Car Rental

Before you rent a car, here are a few important things to know about driving in Malaysia:

1. Foreign Driving Licenses

Expats are allowed to use their foreign driving license in Malaysia for up to three months. After this period, they must apply for an international driving permit. The process varies based on nationality and residency status but is straightforward, particularly for expats from countries with a bilateral agreement (such as Australia, France, Denmark, Singapore). These expats must submit specific documents to a JPJ (Road Transport Department) office.

2. Driving Side

Malaysians drive on the left-hand side of the road.

3. Seat Belt & Child Safety

Seat belts are mandatory for all passengers, both in the front and rear seats. Children under eight years old must be in a child safety seat.

4. Lane Rules

On a three-lane road, the left lane is the slow lane, while the rightmost lane is for faster-moving vehicles. On expressways, you can stay in the middle lane if maintaining a constant speed or not overtaking.

5. Speed Limits

In towns, speed limits generally range between 60km/h and 80km/h. On the North-South Highway, they can increase to between 90km/h and 110km/h. Be cautious, as speed cameras are strategically placed along the roads.

Credits to Avis Car Rental

Whether you need a compact car for city driving or a spacious vehicle for a family trip, Avis has the perfect rental options for you.

items.title: CELEBRATING 25 YEARS OF THE PETRONAS TWIN TOWERS
items.content:
The iconic PETRONAS Twin Towers – a national symbol of Malaysia's architectural prowess and economic growth – turned 25 this year.

To commemorate this significant milestone, a series of exciting art and cultural activities were held at PETRONAS Twin Towers Visit from 30 August until 1 September 2024, attracting over 4,000 visitors.

As part of the festivities, early bird attendees were treated to exclusive anniversary kits filled with cultural-themed door gifts. 

These kits, featuring Kopi O, Teh Tarik, and Cendol pouches, showcased Malaysia's rich culinary heritage and added a touch of local flavour to the celebration.

The event started with a mini exhibition showcasing the stunning architectural photography of renowned local photographers, namely Siva Kumar, Aereon Wong, and Amri Ginang. 

Their works of art truly captured the majesty of the towers and the vibrant city that surrounds them, leaving us awe-struck and inspired.

One of the highlights of the celebration was the opportunity to walk across the Skybridge at Level 41, the world’s highest double-decker bridge connecting the towers. 

As we stepped onto the bridge, we felt a surge of adrenaline. 

We could see the bustling streets, the towering skyscrapers, and the expansive greeneries of KLCC Park, all laid out like a miniature cityscape. 

It was like being on top of the world!

The Observation Deck at Level 86 provides an even more mind-blowing perspective, allowing visitors to admire the city's landmarks and study scale models of the Klang Valley. 

It was a fascinating experience to see familiar places represented in miniature and understand their relative distances.

A special cultural performance greeted visitors when they arrived at Level 83.

The cultural activities held at Level 83 were also a delightful surprise. 

Watching demonstrations of traditional crafts like songket notebook-crafting, mengkuang-weaving and batik-painting brought us closer to Malaysia's colourful cultural heritage. 

We were particularly captivated by the intricate patterns and vibrant hues of the songket fabrics. 

The batik artists, with their steady hands and deft strokes, transformed plain white cloth into works of art that were both beautiful and functional.

Visitors had the opportunity to get their hands on batik painting during the three-day event.

But that’s not all. We were also equally impressed by the exquisite handmade decoupage tiffins, which we knew would make the perfect souvenirs for both local and international visitors. 

Each tiffin is a miniature masterpiece, adorned with intricate designs and vibrant colours. 

The craftsmanship is evident in every detail, from the delicate floral patterns to the smooth, polished finish.

The event concluded with a photo opportunity at the Photo Box, allowing visitors to capture lasting memories of their visit.

Ezarisma Azni Mohamad, CEO of Petrosains Sdn. Bhd., expressed gratitude for the continued support from visitors worldwide. 

He emphasised that the silver jubilee celebration not only marked a significant milestone but also reflected the organisation's commitment to sharing Malaysia's pride with the world.

Zubaidah Mukhtar, the Director-General of Istana Budaya, and Ezarisma Azni Mohamad, Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Petrosains Sdn. Bhd. posed for a picture in front of the scale model of PETRONAS Twin Towers on Level 86.

As a wholly-owned subsidiary of PETRONAS, Petrosains Sdn. Bhd. has successfully managed the visit operations of the PETRONAS Twin Towers and Petrosains, The Discovery Centre®. 

As of June 2024, the towers had welcomed over 7.5 million visitors from around the globe. 

As the towers continue to stand tall as symbols of the nation's progress, they will undoubtedly remain a must-visit destination for years to come.

For more information about PETRONAS Twin Towers Visit, head on to https://www.petronastwintowers.com.my/ or scan the QR code below to purchase your tickets and secure your spot exploring one of the world's most iconic landmarks.

We look forward to welcoming you to the PETRONAS Twin Towers and creating memories that will last a lifetime. See you soon!

Our advanced diagnostic tools include Body Composition Analysis Machines, ECG, X-Ray, Ultrasound, CT Scan machines, Echocardiograms, Lung Function Tests, and Fibroscan. 

These tools enable us to provide comprehensive evaluations, helping patients manage symptoms related to ischaemic heart disease, hypertension, diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and other health conditions. 

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

By offering a holistic approach to health screening, we aim to empower our patients to take control of their health and well-being.

A Multidisciplinary Approach to Health

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

At Cengild Wellness Centre, we believe that health is multifaceted, requiring a multidisciplinary approach to ensure the best outcomes for our patients. 

Our team comprises experts from various medical fields who work together to provide personalised consultation and care. 

Whether you're concerned about your heart health, managing diabetes, or simply want a thorough health assessment, our team is here to support you every step of the way.

Our mission extends beyond just screening for potential health risks. 

We are committed to delivering the best possible treatment and care, ensuring that our patients receive the support they need to lead healthy, fulfilling lives. 

With a focus on preventive care, we offer specific screening programmes tailored to individual needs, helping our patients stay ahead of potential health issues.

A Commitment to Community Wellness

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

The launch of the Wellness Screening Centre at Cengild G.I. Medical Centre marks the beginning of a new chapter in our ongoing efforts to promote health and wellness within our community. 

The support of YB Hannah Yeoh at our inauguration serves as a testament to the importance of our mission. 

We invite you to visit our new Wellness Centre and experience the exceptional care and comprehensive services we offer.

items.title: FEAST ON KUALA LUMPUR'S BEST SMOKED BBQ AT SWOOD SMOKEHOUSE BBQ
items.content:
Credits to Swood Smokehouse

If you're craving authentic smoked BBQ in Kuala Lumpur, look no further than Swood Smokehouse BBQ. 

Nestled in the vibrant neighborhood of Kampung Baru, this Texan-inspired restaurant offers a true taste of Texas right in the heart of the city. 

Swood Smokehouse BBQ is renowned for its commitment to serving up tender, juicy barbecue meats that perfectly satisfy even the most voracious carnivorous cravings.


Credits to Swood Smokehouse

Swood Smokehouse BBQ takes pride in its traditional Texan barbecue techniques, particularly its concept of slow cooking in a smoker. 

This method, which takes around 10-12 hours, ensures that each piece of meat is cooked to perfection, resulting in flavors that are smoky, tender, and incredibly juicy. 

The long, slow smoking process allows the meat to absorb the rich, smoky essence while retaining its natural juices, making every bite an explosion of flavor.

One of the unique aspects of Swood Smokehouse BBQ is its use of local Malaysian wood in the smoking process. 

Credits to Swood Smokehouse

The restaurant utilizes woods from rambutan trees, mangosteen trees, and rubber trees, which impart a distinct and unforgettable flavor to the meats. 

This local twist on traditional Texan barbecue sets Swood Smokehouse apart, offering diners a truly one-of-a-kind culinary experience that blends the best of both worlds.

At Swood Smokehouse BBQ, only premium-grade meats are used, ensuring the highest quality with every dish. 

The restaurant sources its meats from trusted suppliers in New Zealand, Australia, and Argentina, guaranteeing that each cut meets the rigorous standards of true barbecue aficionados. 

Whether you're indulging in their beef ribs, brisket, or pulled lamb, you can be confident that you're enjoying some of the finest meats available.

They also have burnt ends, smoked chicken, and smoked duck as well. 

The sausages, meatballs, and patties served at Swood Smokehouse are all homemade.

Credits to Swood Smokehouse

The beef ribs at Swood Smokehouse BBQ are particularly noteworthy. 

After spending more than 10 hours in the smoker, these ribs become one of the most ordered items on the menu. 

Their unique texture—tender, smoky, and juicy—makes them an absolute must-try for any barbecue lover. 

To fully savor the experience, it’s recommended to pair these succulent ribs with the restaurant’s homemade side dishes and signature sauces, which complement the meats perfectly and enhance the overall dining experience.

Beyond their smoked meats, Swood Smokehouse BBQ also offers a diverse menu that caters to a variety of tastes. 

Credits to Swood Smokehouse

From hearty burgers and meaty pasta dishes to their signature ribs platter, there’s something to satisfy every appetite. 

Each dish is crafted with the same attention to detail and commitment to quality that has made Swood Smokehouse a favorite among Kuala Lumpur’s meat lovers.

For those who appreciate barbecue that’s cooked with precision and passion, Swood Smokehouse BBQ is a culinary haven. 

The restaurant provides a feast for the senses, offering an array of meats that are smoked, barbecued, or roasted to perfection. 

Every dish reflects the essence of true Texan barbecue, with a Malaysian twist that makes it uniquely Swood.

Credits to Swood Smokehouse

Whether you're a local or just visiting Kuala Lumpur, a trip to Swood Smokehouse BBQ promises an unforgettable dining experience. 

The combination of premium meats, traditional smoking techniques, and local flavors creates a barbecue experience that is both authentic and innovative. 

So, if you're looking to indulge in the best smoked BBQ in Kuala Lumpur, Swood Smokehouse BBQ is the place to be.

items.title: EXPLORE THE WONDERS OF MALAYSIA THROUGH MINIATURES AT MINNATURE MALAYSIA
items.content:
Credits to MinNature Malaysia

It's a small world after all! Nestled within Sungei Wang Plaza, MinNature offers an immersive journey into the rich cultural tapestry of Malaysia through an extensive collection of intricately crafted miniatures. 

This unique attraction is an essential destination for those looking to experience an aerial view of Kuala Lumpur while delving into the cultural nuances of Malaysia distinctly and engagingly.

The collection at MinNature is vast, encompassing hundreds of meticulously detailed miniature scenes that capture the essence of Malaysia's diverse culture. 

Among the highlights are traditional Malaysian houses, iconic wau kites, vibrant batik paintings, and representations of the country's renowned culinary delights. 

Credits to MinNature Malaysia

As visitors wander through the gallery, they are invited to escape into these tiny worlds, where each scene tells a story of Malaysia's heritage and way of life.

The gallery is thoughtfully divided into different zones, each offering a unique perspective on Malaysian culture and heritage. 

Credits to MinNature Malaysia

One of the zones, "Taste of Malaysia," showcases miniature culinary scenes that celebrate the nation's rich gastronomic traditions. 

Here, visitors can appreciate the artistry involved in recreating the intricate details of Malaysia’s beloved dishes. 

Credits to MinNature Malaysia

Another zone, "Heritage Buildings," features miniatures of iconic Malaysian architecture, providing insights into the country's historical and cultural landmarks.

A standout feature of MinNature is the Masterbuilders Workshop, where visitors can experience the craft of miniature-making firsthand. 

This interactive space allows guests to engage with the art of creating these tiny masterpieces, offering a deeper appreciation for the skill and creativity of the artists behind them. 

The workshop not only serves as an educational experience but also as a platform to support and recognize the talented individuals who have dedicated their craft to bringing Malaysia’s culture to life in miniature form.

Credits to MinNature Malaysia

The artists at MinNature are true masters of their craft, pouring immense dedication into the creation of each piece. 

The level of detail and intricacy in the miniatures is astounding, with every tiny element carefully crafted to reflect the authenticity and beauty of the scenes they depict. 

Visiting MinNature provides a unique opportunity to admire these works of art up close, allowing guests to truly appreciate the labor of love that goes into each creation. 

By visiting, you not only immerse yourself in Malaysia’s cultural heritage but also support the gifted artists who make this experience possible.

In addition to exploring the miniature worlds, MinNature offers a variety of engaging activities designed to enhance the visitor experience. 

These activities include the "Find Me If You Can" scavenger hunt series, which challenges guests to locate hidden items within the miniatures, adding an element of fun and discovery to the visit. 

There is also the Special Poster Quest, among other interactive experiences that make a trip to MinNature both entertaining and educational.

Credits to MinNature Malaysia

MinNature in Sungei Wang Plaza provides an extraordinary way to explore Kuala Lumpur and Malaysian culture from a new perspective. 

It is more than just a display of miniatures; it is a celebration of Malaysia’s rich heritage and the artistic talents that bring it to life. 

So, what are you waiting for? Discover the miniaturized version of Kuala Lumpur, gain new insights into Malaysian culture, and take part in creative activities that will make your visit truly memorable. 

A visit to MinNature is an opportunity to explore, learn, and support the local artists who have turned their passion into a delightful experience for all to enjoy.

items.title: WELLNESS AT UMRA: YOUR SANCTUARY FOR HOLISTIC HEALING AND REJUVENATION
items.content:
Credits to Wellness at UMRA

At Wellness At UMRA, we believe in a holistic approach to wellness, integrating both Eastern and Western modalities to support your journey towards emotional, mental, and physical well-being. 

The founders’ personal experiences have shaped their belief that complementary therapies can significantly enhance life’s outcomes.

Wellness At Umra has a unique story, which stemmed from its founders’ own personal experience.

They had undergone more than 20 IVF procedures but faced failures. 

However, after a long journey, they decided to do something different.  

Credits to Wellness at UMRA

This time they incorporated alternative therapeutic therapies such as acupuncture, hypnotherapy, traditional massage, relaxation therapy and more. 

This attempt brought them a successful full-term pregnancy and they were blessed with a son 11 years ago.

Hence, they have set up Wellness At Umra to bring these options to their patients undergoing fertility treatment, hoping that it will help others, as much as it has helped them. 

They bring a whole array of therapies under one roof to balance your emotional, mental and physical wellbeing.

Credits to Wellness at UMRA

Acupuncture, an ancient traditional Chinese medicine, improves the flow to the key meridian affecting the reproductive organs. 

It has helped with even reducing menstrual cramps.

Hypnotherapy helps by reducing anxiety and stress, especially whilst undergoing fertility treatments.

We work with each IVF procedure, to facilitate the emotions that may arise with each treatment.

Imagine falling into a peaceful, blissful sleep during one of the most stressful and uncomfortable procedures ever.

Credits to Wellness at UMRA

Traditional Fertility Massage under the hands of an experienced masseur brings about not only relaxation but improved blood circulation especially aimed at the reproductive organs. 

Just before getting your massage, enjoy a relaxing session in a Full Spectrum InfraRed Sauna Cabin designed to stimulate your cells for a more complete detox and tissue regeneration.

Radio Frequency Therapy utilises a device that increases blood flow to the organs and hastens cell tissue repair.

It is rumoured that some of the top English Premier League football clubs have their own personal devices to help the players deal with their sports injuries better.

Credits to Wellness at UMRA

Sound Relaxation Therapy is a sound bath session for deep relaxation to calm your mind and improve your well-being. 

This helps with your mindset especially to release negative emotions and stress while undergoing IVF treatments.

Think about how you feel when you hear a soothing chime or a melodious bell.

This is an example of how sound frequency works in your mind.

Credits to Wellness at UMRA

We do have other therapies designed to help with your emotional needs with trained therapists or come do an Epigenetic Screen Cell Analysis to get a comprehensive report on what is going on inside your body.

A doctor will do a consultation and send you home with a personalised health plan to work on the health issues which come up. 

If you are male and want to enhance your fertility health, look no further.

We work with an experienced male masseur as well whose speciality is male reproductive health.

Before you embark on your fertility journey, come have a chat with us at Wellness At Umra.

items.title: INDULGE IN AUTHENTIC SPANISH FLAVORS FROM MUST-TRY DISHES TO DESSERTS AT EL IBERICO
items.content:
Credits to El Iberico

For those who seek extraordinary culinary experiences in Kuala Lumpur, El Iberico is a hidden treasure, offering an authentic taste of Spain amidst the city's lively atmosphere.

Nestled in the vibrant Seri Bukit Ceylon area of Bukit Bintang, this delightful restaurant promises a dining experience reminiscent of the sun-kissed Mediterranean coast.

When dining at El Iberico, three signature dishes are essential for a memorable culinary journey:

  1. El Iberico Porchetta (Pork Roast)
    This mouthwatering pork roast, accompanied by vegetables, comes in two sizes: 1 kg (perfect for 3-4 people) and 2 kg (suitable for 6-8 people). Both gluten-free and lactose-free, it’s best to order a day in advance to allow the pork skin to dry, ensuring an irresistibly crispy crackling.





  2. El Iberico Pork Ribs
    A true culinary delight, these pork ribs are rich in flavor, thanks to the Iberico pigs' unique metabolism. The fat, high in oleic acid (the main component of olive oil), and the distinct nutty aroma of acorns give these ribs an unforgettable taste. Imported from the Iberian Peninsula and marinated within 24 hours, they are prepared to perfection for maximum tenderness and flavor.

  3. El Iberico Paella
    Paella, originally named after the large, shallow pan used to cook it, is a dish of rice, fish, vegetables, or seafood. The rice used in paella is unique, absorbing stock exceptionally well, expanding three to four times its original size during cooking, and developing an unmatched aroma.

Beyond its savory Spanish dishes, El Iberico also offers a selection of exquisite desserts that create a magical sweet experience, transporting your taste buds to a world of delectable indulgence.

Some dessert highlights include:

  1. Crema Catalana
    A delightful mix of custard, berries, and sugar, Crema Catalana offers a unique blend of flavors sure to satisfy any sweet tooth.

  2. Classic Tiramisu
    End your meal on a high note with this beloved Italian dessert, featuring mascarpone cheese, eggs, biscuits, and cocoa powder.

  3. Panna Cotta
    Conclude your dining experience with the rich, creamy goodness of Panna Cotta, made from cream, milk, and sugar, and topped with berries.

El Iberico not only excels in savory Spanish cuisine but also provides a sweet haven for dessert lovers seeking new culinary adventures in Kuala Lumpur.

Please note that El Iberico is a non-halal establishment, offering an authentic Spanish dining experience with pork and other non-halal ingredients.

items.title: ELEVATE YOUR DINING WITH RECOMMENDED FOODS TO TRY AT CHAKRI RAINTREE SKYBAR
items.content:
Credits to Chakri Raintree Skybar

If you’re in Kuala Lumpur and craving a taste of Thailand with an incredible view, Chakri Raintree Skybar is the place to be. 

Perched atop the Dorsett Hartamas Hotel, this sky-high dining venue offers stunning panoramic views of iconic landmarks like Istana Negara, KLCC, and the KL Tower.

At Chakri Raintree Skybar, the menu is a true celebration of Thailand’s rich culinary heritage, offering a variety of dishes that cater to all tastes. Here are some must-try items that you shouldn’t miss:

  1. Pomelo Seafood Salad



    A vibrant and refreshing salad that’s a burst of flavors, combining juicy pomelo with fresh seafood. Each bite delivers a zesty and invigorating taste, making it a perfect start to your meal.



  2. Asian-Touch Creamy Tomyam Pasta


    A unique fusion dish that blends the bold, spicy flavors of Thai Tom Yum with the creamy richness of Western pasta. This delightful marriage of cuisines offers a comforting yet exciting culinary experience.

  3. Grilled Lemongrass Chicken


    Marinated in aromatic spices and grilled to perfection, this dish showcases the deep, smoky flavors of tender chicken infused with the fresh, citrusy notes of lemongrass.

  4. Tom Yum King Prawn


    A spicy symphony of flavors, this dish features succulent king prawns in a broth that’s both tangy and spicy. It’s a quintessential Thai dish that packs a punch with every spoonful.

  5. Mango Sticky Rice


    For dessert, indulge in this classic Thai treat. Sweet, ripe mangoes are paired with glutinous rice and drizzled with coconut milk, creating a heavenly dessert experience that’s the perfect end to your meal.

The ambiance at Chakri Raintree Skybar is warm and inviting, making it an ideal setting for various occasions. 

Whether you’re planning a romantic dinner under the stars, a lively family gathering, or even a productive business lunch, the skybar’s atmosphere sets the stage for a memorable dining experience.

As you dine, the combination of authentic Thai dishes and the spectacular views of Kuala Lumpur’s skyline will transport you to Thailand, even if just for a meal. 

The rich, bold flavors of the food paired with the stunning scenery create a dining experience that’s truly unparalleled.

If you’re in KL, don’t miss the chance to elevate your dining experience at Chakri Raintree Skybar. 

Whether it’s for the food, the view, or the ambiance, this sky-high venue promises a dining experience you won’t soon forget.

items.title: PETRONAS TWIN TOWERS: A SPECTACULAR SKYLINE ADVENTURE
items.content:
Credits to Petronas Twin Towers

Welcome to Kuala Lumpur, the vibrant capital of Malaysia, where remarkable transformations have taken place.

This city proudly showcases its crown jewel - the magnificent PETRONAS Twin Towers.

Standing tall at a height of 452 meters, these resilient, and progressive twin structures designed by the renowned architect Cesar Pelli symbolise the city's economic growth and embody the aspirations of our nation.

The PETRONAS Twin Towers' design incorporates Islamic geometric forms known as Rub El Hizb, resulting in captivating eight-pointed star-shaped floor plates that embody the principles of unity, harmony, stability, and rationality adding a touch of cultural heritage.

Immerse yourself in the architectural marvel, embrace the cultural heritage, and witness the city's vibrant skyline from extraordinary heights.

The Visit Experience

Step into the foyer at the entrance of the halls, and you'll be greeted by designs and patterns inspired by Malaysia's traditional handicrafts and weaving.

The wall panels and screens pay homage to the intricate hardwood carvings from the East Coast of Peninsular Malaysia, while the floor designs showcase the beauty of 'pandan' weavings and 'bertam' palm wall mattings.

Your journey begins at the Skybridge at Level 41, a breathtaking structure suspended 170 meters above the bustling city streets.

Prepare to be mesmerized by panoramic views that stretch as far as the eye can see.

The Skybridge, connecting the two towers, offers a unique vantage point to observe the city's dynamic skyline.

At Level 83, delve deeper into the story of the Twin Towers as digital displays and informative videos provide further insights into their design and significance.

As the tour continues upward, you'll reach the Observation Deck at Level 86, where a mesmerizing panoramic view of the city skyline awaits.

Explore the architectural masterpiece through interactive Augmented Reality (AR) screens and scale models, to gain a deeper understanding of its grandeur.

Guided Tour Packages

Prepare to be mesmerized when you go on PETRONAS Twin Towers' exclusive tour packages. 

The Symphony Tour grants you behind-the-scenes access to the prestigious Dewan Filharmonik PETRONAS, where you can witness the rehearsal sessions of a world-class symphony orchestra.

Alternatively, the VIP Visit offers an extensive briefing about the towers, followed by a guided tour to the Skybridge and the Observation Deck.

With special arrangements for reserved parking and dedicated lift services, this package ensures a seamless and exclusive visit, enhancing the overall experience.

Credits to Petronas Twin Towers

This guided tour, spanning approximately 45 minutes, begins at the Skybridge at Level 41, includes interactive Augmented Reality (AR) screens at Level 83, and culminates at the Observation Deck at Level 86.

Credits to Petronas Twin Towers

As the PETRONAS Twin Towers celebrate their 25th anniversary this year, a number of activities are planned from August 2024 onwards to mark this significant milestone.

These events will further highlight the cultural and architectural significance of this iconic structure, ensuring a memorable experience for all visitors.

Credits to Petronas Twin Towers

To conclude your visit, make sure to visit the PETRONAS Twin Towers' Gift Shop for a selection of memorable souvenirs to commemorate your extraordinary experience.

Here, you can purchase special momento, limited edition merchandise, and exclusive collectables that capture the essence of this architectural wonder.

Whether it's a scale model of the PETRONAS Twin Towers, unique handcrafted items, or PETRONAS-branded apparel, the Gift Shop offers a variety of keepsakes that make perfect gifts for yourself and your loved ones.

Scan the QR code to purchase your tickets and secure your spot exploring one of the world's most iconic landmarks. We look forward to welcoming you to the PETRONAS Twin Towers and creating memories that will last a lifetime. See you soon!

items.title: PETROSAINS: IGNITING STEM PASSION
items.content:
Credits to Petrosains

Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 now open for registration

Credits to Petrosains

STEM – which stands for Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics – has gained prominence in education and industry for its role in driving economic growth, with institutions nationwide fostering STEM learning to equip youth with skills for future success.

To aid in the continued development and adoption of STEM in Malaysia, Petrosains is bringing back the Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 for its sixth instalment to democratise and make STEM learning accessible for all.

Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024

Credits to Petrosains

Encompassing a holistic combination of learning, meticulous preparation, spirited competition, invaluable networking and seamless collaboration, the Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 is designed to cultivate a holistic and future-proof skillset.

This year’s competition was officially launched at Petrosains, The Discovery Centre at Suria KLCC on May 6 and officiated by Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI) Minister, YB Chang Lih Kang and Petrosains Sdn Bhd's Chief Executive Officer, Ezarisma Azni Mohamad.

“Looking at the importance of STEM around the world, the government always emphasises the implementation of science, technology and innovation activities to unearth the talent of local youth,” said Chang.

Credits to Petrosains

“The Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 is not just an annual event, but an important pillar in accelerating the progress of science, technology and innovation among Malaysians.”

Ezarisma added that this year’s competition will maintain its three main categories, namely Robo Tracer, Robo Sumo and Innovation – with eight sub-categories, themed on sustainability.

“This comprehensive focus also emphasises PETRONAS’ commitment to foster innovation among participants that goes hand-in-hand with environmental sustainability and community well-being.

“This year, the aspect of artificial intelligence (AI) will also be integrated into the Robo Tracer category to offer the participants an opportunity to strengthen their knowledge of the latest technologies.

“This addition will enrich the competition experience and equip participants with skills closely related to the rapidly evolving robotics and AI technology industry.

“By incorporating these aspects into the framework of the competition, participants are encouraged to innovate and contribute to a more sustainable future,” he said.

He added that this year, the competition’s Innovation category also features a new sub-category called “Indigenous Culture and Technology”, which is specially designed for indigenous students in Malaysia, emphasising digital inclusivity and community development by empowering indigenous communities with STEM knowledge and promoting projects centred around environmental sustainability.

The competition structure is designed to prepare participants with basic training in design, coding and the use of sensors in robotics development, as well as educate the public on the rapid developments of the digital age, such as robotics, AI and the Internet of Things (IoT).

STEM strengthening sessions

Credits to Petrosains

There will also be workshops and educational sessions for participants held throughout the competition period to strengthen their STEM knowledge, as well as providing unlimited access to learning modules, open-source coding software and a wide range of robotics tools and equipment.

“Providing this form of support to participants helps give them a headstart, by allowing them to learn new skills and knowledge, which are crucial for the future workforce,” said Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 project director Norhana Hamim.

“By engaging in experiential learning, participants will see how interesting STEM can be, which is why we hope this competition will not just spark, but also sustain youth’s interest in STEM, and encourage them to get involved in STEM-related careers, which are in high demand.”

Registration for the Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 is open till 31 July 2024. Teams participating in this competition are asked to submit video entries to showcase their robot creations that can solve problems or deliver innovative ideas.

Credits to Petrosains

The final round of the Petrosains RBTX Challenge 2024 will be held in October 2024, with the Zone Qualifying Phase conducted from August to September 2024.

Winners of this competition stand a chance to win cash prizes worth more than RM48,000 and compete at the ALL-JAPAN ROBOT-SUMO TOURNAMENT 2024.

Since its inception in 2018, the Petrosains RBTX Challenge has impacted over 50,000 individuals in Malaysia and internationally, with roughly 4,700 teams making up over 14,000 participants.


To register and for more information, visit rbtxchallenge.com

items.title: CHECK OUT RAPID KL'S NEW DEMAND RESPONSIVE TRANSIT (DRT) SHUTTLE VAN SERVICE
items.content:
Credits to MyRapid

Public transport users listen up! Let us pique your interest with Rapid KL's new Demand Responsive Transit (DRT) shuttle van!

Rapid KL is introducing an exciting new service designed to make your commuting experience more convenient and efficient. 

Responding to the overwhelming feedback from public transport users, Rapid KL has launched the Demand Responsive Transit (DRT) shuttle van service. 

This new initiative aims to ease your journey with affordable, flexible, and reliable transportation options.

For just RM1 per trip, the Rapid KL X Trek Rides shuttle van provides an incredibly economical way to travel. 

This service is designed to cater to the needs of commuters who rely on public transport to get around Kuala Lumpur and the Klang Valley. 

The DRT shuttle van operates daily from 6 am to 11:30 pm, ensuring that you can reach your destination comfortably and conveniently throughout the day.

Credits to Asia Mobiliti

To use this service, you need to download the appropriate app, which varies depending on your location.

Once the app is installed, you can select your zone and location, enter your destination, and make a booking. 

The app will then display the shuttle van's number plate and provide an estimated arrival time, making it easy for you to plan your journey.

The DRT service supports cashless payments, adding to the convenience of this new commuting option. 

You can pay the RM1 fare using methods such as the Touch 'n Go card, MyRapid Concession Card, OKU Smile Pass, or cash. 

This flexibility in payment options ensures that you can use the service without worrying about having the exact change or dealing with cash transactions.

Currently, the DRT service is available in select areas as part of a trial run. 

This initial phase aims to gather feedback and assess the effectiveness of the service before a broader rollout across the Klang Valley. 

The trial has already received positive responses, and Rapid KL plans to expand the service to more routes soon.

As part of the trial run, the DRT service is available at specific stations. 

Commuters can book rides through various applications depending on their route. The routes currently included in the trial are:

  • T203: LRT Taman Melati to Danau Kota (book through Trek Rides)
  • T582: LRT Sri Petaling to Bandar Sri Petaling (book through Trek Rides)
  • T774: LRT Glenmarie to MSU, Stadium Shah Alam (book through Mobi)
  • T783: LRT Taman Bahagia to SS7 Petaling Jaya (book through Kumpool)
  • T785: LRT Taman Paramount to Sungai Way (book through Kumpool)
  • T789: LRT Universiti to Universiti Malaya via Pantai Hillpark (book through Trek Rides)
  • T221: LRT Sri Rampai to Giant Ulu Kelang (book through Kumpool)

    These routes have been selected to address key areas and provide commuters a smoother, more convenient travel experience.
    • Credits to Selangor Mobiliti

    The DRT service ensures that you can easily get to your desired destination, whether travelling for work, school, or leisure.

    This service not only improves accessibility but also enhances the overall public transport network in the city. 

    With the ability to book rides via an app, commuters have more control over their travel plans and can avoid the stress of waiting at bus stops or dealing with unpredictable schedules.


    Rapid KL's new Demand Responsive Transit (DRT) shuttle van service is set to revolutionize public transport in Kuala Lumpur.

    So, if you're looking for a cost-effective and hassle-free way to explore Kuala Lumpur, consider using the Rapid KL X Trek Rides shuttle van. 

    Download the relevant app, book your ride, and experience the convenience and reliability of this innovative transport solution. 

    With Rapid KL's DRT service, getting around the city has never been easier.

    Stay tuned for new routes coming your way soon!
