items.title: EXPERIENCE EXCITING ACTIVITIES NEAR THE EVERLY PUTRAJAYA
items.content:
Credits to The Everly Putrajaya

When staying at The Everly Putrajaya, a world of exciting activities awaits just beyond your doorstep. 

Whether you're an architecture enthusiast, nature lover, adventure seeker, or food aficionado, Putrajaya offers a diverse range of experiences. 

Here are the top five activities you should not miss during your stay:

1. Visit the Majestic Putra Mosque

A visit to the Putra Mosque is a must for anyone in Putrajaya. 

As the principal mosque of the city, it stands as a beacon of Islamic architecture, infused with modern and Moorish elements. 

Opened in 1999, this stunning mosque can accommodate up to 15,000 worshippers. 

Its unique rose-tinted granite façade, combined with intricate design details, creates a captivating sight. 

Located next to Perdana Putra, the Malaysian Prime Minister’s office, the mosque is surrounded by a vibrant area where families often spend their leisure time. 

The serene ambiance and the architectural splendor of the mosque make it an essential stop on your itinerary.

2. Immerse Yourself in Nature at Putrajaya Wetland

Credits to Perbadanan Putrajaya

Taman Wetland Putrajaya, Malaysia’s first artificial wetland, is a premier ecotourism destination that offers a tranquil retreat into nature. 

This serene sanctuary is home to a diverse array of exotic plants, animals, and birds. 

Early morning visits are particularly rewarding, as the area is alive with activity. 

Climb up the Lookout Tower for breathtaking panoramic views of Putrajaya and its surroundings. 

The Lake Recreation Centre is another highlight, offering paddle boats, kayaking, canoeing, and other water activities. 

Don’t miss the Flamingo Pond, where you can observe flamingos in their natural habitat, adding to the sense of peace and relaxation this wetland provides.

3. Enjoy a Scenic Cruise at Tasik Putrajaya

Credits to Cruise Tasik Putrajaya

For a unique perspective of Putrajaya, embark on a river sightseeing cruise at Tasik Putrajaya. 

This 45-minute boat ride allows you to take in some of the city's most iconic landmarks from the water. 

You'll get unparalleled views of the Putra Mosque and the striking Putrajaya Bridge, as well as numerous other architectural marvels along the lakeside. 

This cruise offers a serene and scenic escape, perfect for couples, families, or solo travelers looking to see Putrajaya from a different angle.

4. Take Instagrammable Photos at Moroccan Pavilion Putrajaya

The Moroccan Pavilion Putrajaya is a hidden gem, perfect for those who love to capture beautiful moments. 

This pavilion, which celebrates Malaysia-Morocco diplomatic relations, features breathtaking Moorish architecture and intricate Moroccan designs. 

Constructed with authentic materials and crafted by skilled Moroccan artisans, the pavilion is surrounded by lush gardens and a tranquil lake. 

Every corner of this pavilion offers a picturesque setting, making it an ideal spot for Instagrammable photos that will leave your followers in awe.

5. Makan-Makan at Ayer@8

Credits to Perbadanan Putrajaya

No trip is complete without indulging in local cuisine, and Ayer@8 is the perfect place for a gastronomic adventure. 

Inspired by the waterfront promenades of Venice, Ayer@8 in Precinct 8 offers stunning views of the Tuanku Mizan Zainal Abidin Mosque and a vibrant dining scene. 

Here, you can explore a variety of eateries that cater to all tastes. 

From local Malaysian dishes to international favorites, the culinary options are diverse and delectable. 

After your meal, take a leisurely stroll along the waterfront, enjoying the relaxed atmosphere and scenic beauty of this charming area.

Credits to The Everly Putrajaya

Staying at The Everly Putrajaya places you in the heart of a city brimming with diverse attractions and activities.

Make the most of your stay by exploring these top activities and immerse yourself in the vibrant and multifaceted charm of Putrajaya. 

 Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or a culinary journey, Putrajaya has it all, promising an unforgettable experience.

items.title: UNLIMITED TRAVEL FOR TWO DAYS IN KUALA LUMPUR WITH THE KL TRAVELPASS
items.content:
Credits to KLIA Ekspres

Planning a trip to Kuala Lumpur, the vibrant capital city of Malaysia, but worried about transportation costs? Here’s a fantastic life hack for you! 

With the KL TravelPass, you can enjoy unlimited travel on public transport for two days, allowing you to explore the city effortlessly and affordably.

The KL TravelPass offers unlimited travel for two consecutive days on a variety of public transport options. 

This means you can hop on and off trains, RapidKL buses, and other forms of public transport as much as you like without worrying about extra costs. 

It’s a perfect solution for budget-conscious travelers who want to make the most of their time in Kuala Lumpur.

One of the biggest advantages of using public transport in Kuala Lumpur is the ability to avoid the city’s notorious traffic jams. 

By taking trains, buses, and other public transport options, you can breeze past the gridlock and reach your destinations more quickly. 

This is especially handy in a bustling metropolis like Kuala Lumpur, where traffic can be unpredictable.

Credits to Jom Jalan

Conveniently, the KL TravelPass covers all your transport needs in one handy card. 

It includes the KLIA Ekspres Airport Transfer and provides two days of unlimited rides on the KL Monorail, LRT, and MRT lines! 

This comprehensive coverage makes it easy to explore the city’s famous attractions without the hassle of buying separate tickets or worrying about currency exchange.

With the KL TravelPass, you’ll have unlimited access to Rapid KL rail services, allowing you to visit Kuala Lumpur’s top attractions with ease. 

Whether you’re heading to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, exploring the bustling markets, or discovering hidden gems, the TravelPass ensures you can move around the city effortlessly.

The KL TravelPass is not only affordable but also incredibly convenient. You don’t need to carry multiple tickets or worry about exchanging money for transport fares. The pass covers it all, making your travel experience in Kuala Lumpur smooth and stress-free.


The KL TravelPass includes a one-way or return trip on the KLIA Ekspres, providing a seamless transfer from the airport to the city center. 

Additionally, the pass grants you two consecutive days of unlimited travel on the Monorail, LRT, and MRT lines. 

The KLIA Ekspres trip remains valid for one month from the selected travel date, while the unlimited rail rides must be used within two consecutive days from the first ride, which should be taken within 31 days of purchase.


In addition to unlimited rides on trains, you can add cash value to your KL TravelPass card to enjoy further benefits. 

This added value allows you to travel on Rapid KL buses and KTM Komuter rail services. 

Plus, you can use the card to pay at selected retail and food and beverage outlets, adding even more convenience to your travels.

Credits to KLIA2 Info

The KL TravelPass is available in two packages to suit different travel needs. 

The KL TravelPass Single, priced at RM80.00, includes a one-way trip on the KLIA Ekspres, while the KL TravelPass Return, priced at RM125.00, includes a return trip. 

Both packages provide the same benefits of unlimited travel on Kuala Lumpur’s rail network for two consecutive days.


You can purchase the KL TravelPass at several locations:

  • KLIA Terminal 1: International Arrival, Level 3, and Platform, Level 1
  • KLIA Terminal 2: International Arrival, Level 2, and gateway@klia2, Level 2
  • KL Sentral: KLIA Ekspres Departure Hall, Level 1


    Alternatively, you can purchase your KL TravelPass online through the KLIA Ekspres website and redeem the voucher at the ticket counter upon arrival.

    • Credits to KLIA2 Info

    Using the KL TravelPass is straightforward. Simply tap the card on the Touch ‘n Go reader at the entry gate and tap again on the reader at the exit gate to complete your trip. 

    This simple process makes it easy to navigate the city’s public transport system without any hassle.


    The KL TravelPass is a fantastic solution for travelers looking to explore Kuala Lumpur without breaking the bank. 

    With unlimited travel for two days on a wide range of public transport options, you can see the city’s top attractions, avoid traffic jams, and enjoy a convenient, cost-effective travel experience. 

    Whether you’re visiting for a short trip or planning an extended stay, the KL TravelPass offers an excellent way to get around Kuala Lumpur. 

    So,on your next trip to the vibrant capital of Malaysia, make sure to get your KL TravelPass and experience the city like never before.


    For more information, visit www.kliaekspres.com

items.title: 3 MUST TRY DISHES AT EL IBERICO KUALA LUMPUR
items.content:
Credits to El Iberico

Are you in Kuala Lumpur and seeking a dining spot with a rustic yet elegant interior? 

Look no further! Immerse yourself in the rich flavors of authentic Spanish cuisine at El Iberico.

After a day of exploring KL city, treat yourself to mouth-watering dishes that will transport you straight to the streets of Spain. 

Nestled in the vibrant heart of Kuala Lumpur, El Iberico is a hidden gem that offers a genuine taste of Spain for both locals and travelers alike. 

Located in the bustling Seri Bukit Ceylon area of Bukit Bintang, this charming eatery promises an unforgettable dining experience reminiscent of the sunny Mediterranean beaches.

When you visit El Iberico, there are three must-try dishes that will make your culinary journey truly memorable:

1. El Iberico Porchetta (Pork Roast)

Credits to El Iberico

This succulent pork roast, served with a side of vegetables, is available in two sizes: 1 kg (suitable for 3-4 people) and 2 kg (ideal for 6-8 people). 

It is both gluten-free and lactose-free. For the best results, it is recommended to order a day in advance, allowing the pork skin to dry out and achieve that perfect crisp crackling. 

Credits to El Iberico

This dish is a testament to the art of Spanish cooking, where patience and attention to detail yield a deliciously satisfying meal.

2. El Iberico Pork Ribs

Credits to El Iberico

El Iberico’s pork ribs are a true delicacy, rich in flavor due to the unique metabolism of the Iberico pigs, which produces fat containing high levels of oleic acid (the primary component of olive oil) and a distinct nutty aroma of acorns. 

These ribs are imported from the Iberian Peninsula and marinated within 24 hours to ensure optimal taste and tenderness. 

Credits to El Iberico

Choose from three delectable flavors: Original, Herbs & Spices, and Beer & Mustard. Each portion includes approximately 3-4 ribs (430 grams), making it a hearty and flavorful choice for any meat lover.

3. El Iberico Paella

Credits to El Iberico

The term "paella" originally referred to the large, shallow pan with two handles used to prepare rice, fish, vegetables, or seafood. 

Traditionally, paella was served on special occasions and eaten outdoors. 

Today, paella can be made with a wide variety of ingredients. 

Credits to El Iberico

The rice used in paella is particularly special, as it absorbs the stock well, expanding three to four times its original size during cooking without bursting, and developing an unparalleled aroma. 

At El Iberico, you can order a single or double portion of paella, or opt for the El Iberico family pack, Paella Valenciana, which serves 4-6 people.


Credits to El Iberico

To complement these exquisite dishes, El Iberico offers a wide selection of wines, beers, and unique cocktails. 

Whether you're sipping on a robust Spanish red wine or a refreshing sangria, the carefully curated drink menu enhances your meal and elevates your dining experience.

Credits to El Iberico

Please note that El Iberico is a non-halal establishment, providing an authentic Spanish dining experience featuring pork and other non-halal ingredients. 

Despite this, the restaurant boasts a diverse menu and a cozy ambiance, ensuring a truly exceptional dining experience for all who visit.

If you're in Kuala Lumpur and craving the rich, vibrant flavors of Spanish cuisine, make sure to visit El Iberico.

From the rustic yet classy interior to the meticulously crafted dishes, El Iberico offers a slice of Spain right in the heart of Kuala Lumpur. 

Don't miss out on this extraordinary dining experience—head to El Iberico today and savor the authentic taste of Spain!

Situated in the heart of the city along Gaya Street, Polaris Suite, formerly known as Wushiba Apartment, offers a prime location just opposite Lintasan Daesoka.

Housed within a sprawling complex, the museum features exhibits on local history, art, and culture, offering insights into the diverse traditions of the region.

2. Atkinson Clock Tower

Credits to Sabah Museum

Be mesmerized by Kota Kinabalu's oldest standing building, the Atkinson Clock Tower.

Perched atop Signal Hill Road, this iconic landmark offers panoramic views of the city and Sabah's stunning coastline.

3. Handicraft Market

Have a shopping spree at Sabah's Handicraft Market, where you'll find an array of unique souvenirs and local treasures.

As night falls, the waterfront comes alive with bustling bars and entertainment, making it the perfect spot for a night out on the town.

Adorned with colourful murals and graffiti, this creative space showcases the talents of local artists and provides a unique insight into Sabah's urban culture.


After a day of exploration, guests can return to the comfort of the Polaris Suite and unwind amidst the serene surroundings.

Whether enjoying a leisurely stroll along Gaya Street or simply relaxing in the comfort of their apartment, guests can savour every moment of their Kota Kinabalu getaway.

Polaris Suite is definitely the perfect choice for your next adventure in Sabah's capital city due to its convenient location and stylish accommodations!

items.title: INTO THE HEART OF BORNEO: TABIN WILDLIFE RESERVE EXPLORATION
items.content:
Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

Located in the eastern region of Sabah, Malaysia, on the stunning island of Borneo, you will find the expansive Tabin Wildlife Reserve.

Encompassing a sprawling 300,000 acres, Tabin is renowned as the largest wildlife reserve in Malaysia.

For those in search of the enchanting wonders of Borneo, Tabin Wildlife Reserve is a must-visit destination.

It is recognized as the "Best Tourist Attraction" by Malaysia Tourism, which captivates visitors with its natural allure.

The reserve, awarded during the 19th Malaysia Tourism Awards 2014/2015, definitely stands out for its eco-tourism offerings.

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

Nestled in the centre of the Dent Peninsula, Tabin Wildlife Reserve invites explorers with its vibrant scenery, varied wildlife, and fascinating natural wonders.

FOLLOW our social media @KLTheGuide for more interesting travel contents in Kuala Lumpur!

Just a 1 hour and 15-minute drive from Lahad Datu, with a stretch of gravel road, Tabin provides a haven for untouched nature to flourish.

Established in 1984, the Tabin Wildlife Reserve is a designated protected area known for its diverse range of wildlife.

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

The reserve is home to several endangered species such as the Borneo Pygmy Elephant, Sumatran Rhinoceros, and Tembadau.

Along with nine species of primates and three species of wild cats, all of which are protected under wildlife laws. 

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

Bird watchers will also enjoy Tabin as it is home to over 300 species of birds from four different families, making it a recognized Important Bird Area. (IBA: MY027)

Tabin Wildlife Reserve is known for its active mud volcanoes that are rich in minerals, drawing in a variety of wildlife in search of essential nutrients.

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

These unique features are ideal spots for observing wildlife and birdwatching, providing visitors with a rare opportunity to witness the dynamic ecosystem of Tabin.

Exploring the wilderness of Tabin brings a range of exciting experiences. 

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

Trekking through the jungle reveals the wonders of the rainforest, and night safaris give a glimpse of nocturnal animals in their habitat.

Guided night walks provide an exhilarating journey through the dark jungle, with only torchlight for illumination.

Dawn drives give opportunities to see wildlife and birds as they start their day, and a swim in the clear waters of Lipad Waterfall is a refreshing break from the heat of the tropics.

Also, treat yourself to a Tabin Rainforest Herbal Foot Soak for a relaxing end to a day filled with excitement.

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

On top of that, the Tabin Wildlife Resort provides cozy lodging options amid nature, with river chalets and hill chalets offering a peaceful escape following a day of adventure.

Credits to Tabin Wildlife Resort

Each accommodation is equipped with contemporary conveniences such as private bathrooms, air conditioning, and secluded balconies with stunning views of either the lush forest or the calm Lipad River.

Explore the wonders of Tabin Wildlife Reserve by immersing yourself in the breathtaking greenery.

To sum up, a trip to Tabin Wildlife Reserve offers a remarkable adventure through the beauty of Borneo.

With its wide range of wildlife, stunning scenery, and engaging activities, Tabin encourages visitors to rediscover nature and make lasting memories in the peaceful rainforest.

What are you waiting for?

Book a trip to Sabah and explore the enchanting Tabin Wildlife Reserve today!

items.title: "CURIOSITY COMES ALIVE" AS PETROSAINS KICKS OFF 25TH ANNIVERSARY WITH SILVER JUBILEE CARNIVAL
items.content:
Credits to Petrosains

 Petrosains, The Discovery Centre commemorated its 25th Anniversary Carnival from March 1st to 3rd, 2024, with an extraordinary celebration of science, technology, and innovation.

Over three days, nearly 30,000 visitors flocked to Petrosains, The Discovery Centre in Kuala Lumpur, as well as its satellite PlaySmart centres across Johor Bahru, Kota Kinabalu, Kuantan, and Kuching.

Credits to Petrosains

The festivities kicked off at Petrosains, The Discovery Centre in Suria KLCC, with an inauguration by Syed M Muhafiz Syed M Bakar, a member of the Petrosains Board of Directors.

The highlight of the event was the exclusive "Night at The Discovery Centre" on March 1st, which featured exhilarating activities such as the LED Light Drum Show and a stage performance by Insomniacks.

Credits to Petrosains

To accommodate the excitement, the centre extended its hours until 10.00 pm, compared to the usual 6.30 pm closing time.

Additionally, 50 lucky visitors sporting the best science-themed costumes were rewarded with special gifts.

Traveling from Terengganu, Mohd. Zalani, an engineering lecturer at Universiti Malaysia Terengganu, expressed his family's unforgettable experience at the carnival, praising the exclusive "passport" provided during the event for guiding them through the exhibits and galleries.

During the carnival's first day, Ifah, aged 13, showcased her passion for biology and biofuel by winning a quiz during the Meet the Expert session on Algae Fuel of the Future, presented by PETRONAS.

This session provided valuable insights into sustainability and carbon emissions mitigation, enriching her understanding beyond the classroom.

Meanwhile, Ifah's sister, Aisyah, aged 9, enjoyed exploring the Geotime Diorama with its captivating dinosaurs, while Omar, aged 16, fulfilled his dream of racing on a virtual track with the F1 simulator at the SPEED! gallery.

Credits to Petrosains

The carnival offered a plethora of engaging activities, including Meet the Expert sessions, Workshops, and Science Shows.

These sessions covered various topics such as Upcycling, Mangrove Show, Cool Chemistry, Cryogenic Show, Drone and Laser Show, designed to enhance analytical and critical thinking skills while fostering a lifelong curiosity for science.

Furthermore, Petrosains collaborated with esteemed partners such as Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP), Pusat Sains Negara, Aquaria, Sustainable Energy Development Authority (SEDA), Pengurusan Air Selangor Sdn Bhd, and Grup Buku Karangkraf to enrich the STEM learning experience.

Credits to Petrosains

These partnerships showcased a commitment to enhancing STEM education through interactive demonstrations and activities, ranging from chemical experiments to discussions on biodiversity and marine conservation.

Petrosains CEO, Ezarisma Azni Mohamad, expressed gratitude to the visitors, communities, and supporters who have journeyed with Petrosains over the past 25 years.

He emphasized Petrosains' mission to promote STEM literacy and inspire creativity and innovation driven by science and technology.

Since its inception in 1999, Petrosains has reached 26 million individuals through various physical and online learning platforms.

Credits to Petrosains

With its diverse exhibitions and thematic galleries, Petrosains continues to provide immersive experiences that ignite interest in STEM subjects.

From exploring the wonders of astronomy to understanding prehistoric life and delving into chemistry and petrochemicals, Petrosains remains committed to fostering sustainability and addressing real-world challenges through STEM education.

Located next to the natural splendour of the Kalumpang Rainforest Jungle, Beacon Resort is not just a destination; it's an immersive tapestry of unforgettable experiences that beckons travellers seeking a harmonious blend of relaxation and adventure.

Embark on an expedition through verdant forests, immerse yourself in the wilderness and feel the untamed beauty of the wild plants brushing against you during the jungle trekking experience.

Beacon Resort is proud to introduce the first Hot & Cold Hydrogen Spa in Malaysia.

Immerse yourself in the therapeutic benefits of hydrogen-infused water for a unique and revitalising spa experience.

Credits to Beacon Resort

Indulge in a sensory journey with Beacon Resort's Functional Relaxation Therapy Massage using 8 doTERRA essential oils.

Unwind as skilled therapists blends aromatherapy with massage techniques to create a holistic experience that harmonises your senses.

Beacon Resort is proud to be home to the majestic Rajah Brooke's Birdwing butterfly, Malaysia's national butterfly.

Take a stroll through the resort's butterfly sanctuary and see these stunning creatures in their natural habitat - a rare opportunity to connect with Malaysia's rich biodiversity.

Credits to Beacon Resort

Step into a world of architectural wonder with our 147-meter-long White Wave Wall.

Imagine taking a leisurely stroll through this enchanting creation, immersed in a Santorini-like atmosphere that transports you to realm of tranquility.

The lookout points invite you on a unique journey, each step fostering a connection with the river and a deep appreciation of the surrounding beauty.

items.title: SPEND AN EVENTFUL DAY AT FARM IN THE CITY
items.content:
Credits to Farm In The City

Who says you have to travel far to enjoy the farm life?

Escape the urban hustle and bustle and have a nature getaway where you can get up close and personal with adorable farm animals.

FARM IN THE CITY combines elements of nature and wildlife in a carefully designed setting resembling a conservation park.

Farm In The City offers a remarkable experience that bridges the gap between urban living and rural charm.

Credits to Farm In The City

Nestled right in the heart of the bustling Klang Valley, Farm In The City offers a delightful escape into the world of furry, feathered, and friendly animals.

With inspiration from Malaysia's mixed and cosmopolitan population, Farm In The City was developed to resemble a typical Malaysian village or 'kampung' scene. 

This zoo houses a wide variety of animal species with more than 100 different tame and exotic animal species that can be interacted with here.

Step inside and prepare to be greeted by a diverse array of animals, from cuddly bunnies and charming guinea pigs to playful goats and elegant swans.

There is also an orchard on the farm with a massive exhibition of more than 60 tropical fruit trees and exotic vegetation.

The highlight of your visit?

Credits to Farm In The City

The chance to interact closely with these adorable creatures.

Unlike traditional zoos, Farm In The City encourages hands-on experiences.

Imagine the thrill of patting a mini horse or holding a baby chick gently in your hands.

Feed colourful parrots and other birds and pet cute alpacas as they roam around the farm.

Join our March Giveaway contest to win a 2D1N luxury stay in KL!

These interactions create precious memories that both children and adults will cherish.

Farm In The City isn't just about fun and games; it's an educational experience too. 

The children will definitely enjoy themselves because they are able to meet and pet cute animals!

They will discover the value of protecting the environment and how it affects the lives of these lovely creatures.

There's no shortage of activities to keep you entertained throughout the day.

Credits to Farm In The City

Here's a rundown of what you can expect:

10.00 am: The farm opens, with an early opening at 9.30 am on weekends and holidays.

10.15 am: Witness Turaco Feeding at the Aviary and observe their behavior up close.

Credits to Farm In The City

10.30 am: Experience Pelican Feeding at the Pelican Enclosure and marvel at their feeding habits.

10.45 am: Head to the Jungle Walk for Lemur Feeding and learn more about these fascinating creatures.

11.00 am: Don't miss Otter Feeding at the Exhibition area for a dose of cuteness.

Credits to Farm In The City

11.15 am: Get up close and personal with the animals during the Meet & Greet session.

2.15 pm: Catch Porcupines Feeding at Jungle Walk and be amazed by their behavior.

2.30 pm: Learn about Meerkats during the feeding time at Twilight Creatures.

Credits to Farm In The City

2.45 pm: Enjoy Lorikeet Feeding at the Aviary and maybe even try feeding them yourself.

Credits to Farm In The City

3.00 pm: Be entertained by the Parrot Show at Kampung Mahmood.

Credits to Farm In The City

4.15 pm: Join the second Meet & Greet session of the day for more animal interactions.

6.00 pm: The farm closes, signaling the end of a fun-filled day.

Basically, Farm In The City is a perfect blend of relaxation, education, and joy.

So why wait? Plan your visit to Farm In The City today and immerse yourself in a day of animal adventures right in the heart of the city!

items.title: UNVEILING OF GOH KHEAN LEE ENDOSCOPY CENTRE AT CENGILD G. I. MEDICAL CENTRE
items.content:
Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

The Goh Khean Lee Endoscopy Centre was recently introduced on 8th, January 2024 at the Cengild G. I. Medical Centre, to memorialise contributions by the late Emeritus Professor Dato' Dr. Goh Khean Lee in gastrointestinal & hepatology.

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

The Endoscopy Centre is made up of three scope rooms and eleven daycare observation and holding rooms.

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

Emeritus Professor Dato' Dr. Goh Khean Lee

Emeritus Professor Dato' Dr. Goh Khean Lee ("Dato' Dr. Goh") is the Executive Director of the Company and Head of Medical Advisory Board and Head of Department, Endoscopy of the Group's medical centre.

He was appointed as the Executive Director and the Head of Medical Advisory Board and Head of Department, Endoscopy on 4 May 2021 and 1 May 2021 respectively.

He graduated with a Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery from University Malaya thereafter, completed the qualifying examination to be a member of the Royal Colleges of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow, and obtained his Degree of Doctor of Medicine from Universiti Malaya.

Dato' Dr. Goh is a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians in (United Kingdom), a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians London, a fellow of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Glasgow, American College of Gastroenterology, a fellow and member of the Academy of Medicine of Malaysia and American Society of Gastrointestinal Endoscopy.

He was also conferred honorary fellowships by the Hong Kong Society.

He was President of the Asian Pacific Association of Gastroenterology from 2010 to 2014, President of the Asian Pacific Digestive Week from 2014 to 2018, Vice President of the World Gastroenterology Organization from 2011 to 2015, Chairman Journal of Gastroenterology and Hepatology Foundation from 2012 to 2016 and Editor in Chief of the Journal of Gastroenterology and Hepatology Open from 2017 to the current time.

He is a member of the Malaysian Society of Gastroenterology and Hepatology and has served as president and committee member of various terms.

He was conferred the Merdeka Award in 2011 for "Outstanding Scholastic Achievement" for "Elevating the Practice of Gastroenterology and Hepatology to Global Standards in Malaysia". 

He was also conferred the title of Emeritus Professor by Universiti Malaya.

Dato' Dr. Goh worked from 1980 to 2016 with Universiti Malaya, the University of Malaya Medical Centre. 

Concurrently, for his employment with Universiti Malaya, he also began teaching as a lecturer and was promoted to associate professor and later on Professor.

He was also appointed as the Head of the Gastroenterology and Gastrointestinal Endoscopy Unit in Universiti Malaya, a position he served until his retirement in 2016.

As the head of the unit, he was responsible for creating and advancing the Gastro-Intestinal Endoscopy unit, to which the World Organization of Digestive Endoscopy accorded the high distinction of Centre of Excellence to the Gastro-Intestinal Endoscopy unit in 2008. 

Credits to Cengild G. I. Medical Centre

Frittata Sandwich

Credits to El Iberico

Let's start with the Frittata Sandwich, a delightful combination of eggs, zucchini, Parmesan cheese, and Iberico cheese.

Simply saute the zucchini, beat the eggs with milk and Parmesan, then bake until golden brown.

Cut into squares, layer with Iberico cheese, and finish with dried tomatoes for an extra burst of flavor.

Porchetta

Credits to El Iberico

For the main course, indulge in the tantalizing Porchetta.

Score the pork belly, season with a mixture of spices including fennel seed, sage, and garlic, then roll and tie into a log.

Roast until the skin is crispy and golden brown, basting with drippings for maximum flavor.

Passion Fruit Panna Cotta

Credits to El Iberico

Combine passion fruit pulp with cream, coconut cream, and sugar, then simmer until thickened.

Add gelatin to set, then chill until firm.

Top with fresh passion fruit pulp for a burst of tropical flavor.


These recipes are not only delicious but also easy to prepare at home.

If you are in the vibrant city of Kuala Lumpur and have been yearning to savor the true essence of Malaysia, look no further than the iconic chicken rice dish.

The chicken rice comprises aromatic rice, flavorful chicken, and a side of comforting soup - a symphony of taste that captures the spirit of Malaysian cuisine.

Credits to Nam Heong Chicken Rice

Chicken rice, a staple in Kuala Lumpur's culinary scene, features tender, delicately sauteed white chicken or roasted, poached and expertly sliced into bite-sized portions.

Accompanied by a zesty garlic-chilli dip, garnished with fresh coriander leaf springs, and drizzled with sesame oil, this dish is a gastronomic delight available across the city, from humble hawker stalls to upscale dining venues.

It's a must-try during your visit!

Credits to Nam Heong Chicken Rice

One destination for this delectable experience is Nam Heong Chicken Rice.

A household name since 1938, Nam Heong has earned a special place in the hearts of locals for its renowned Hainanese chicken rice.

Credits to Nam Heong Chicken Rice

With three branches across Malaysia, this dish offers two variations of chicken - the premium "veggie farm" chicken, known for its lean and firm flesh, and the free-range version, celebrated for its succulent and tender meat.

At this Hainanese kopitiam, the tradition remains unchanged, and the same delightful chicken rice that delighted taste buds 60 years ago is still served.

Credits to Nam Heong Chicken Rice

Whether you opt for the silky poached chicken or the crispy roasted bird, both exemplify perfection in their respective categories.

Pair your choice of poultry or pork with fragrant, fluffy rice cooked in chicken stock, infused with the aromatic essence of pandan leaves and glistening with margarine. 

Nam Heong's commitment to authenticity extends to its in-house creations, from the sweet-tangy chili sauce to the slightly spicy pounded ginger paste.

Credits to Nam Heong Chicken Rice

The menu also boasts barbecue meats, including the irresistible roast pork belly with its crispy skin and alternating layers of fat and lean meat.

You can also opt for noodles instead of rice based on your preference.

Head over to Nam Heong Chicken Rice and indulge in the rich flavors of Kuala Lumpur's culinary heritage and make Nam Heong a must-visit stop on your food exploration adventure.

Credits to Ava Skin

If you've been feeling a bit down about your skin and its imperfections, Ava Skin is here to boost your confidence and unveil a more radiant you!

At Ava Skin, they offer a range of treatments to cater to your skin's unique needs. 

A thread lift is a nonsurgical procedure that lifts and tightens your skin for a younger look. 

It's a less invasive procedure than facelift surgery and can often be performed in under 45 minutes without needing to go under a scalpel.

Credits to Ava Skin

The threads stimulate the production of collagen, naturally improving skin elasticity.

Collagen creates firmer, more supple skin and naturally diminishes with age.

Results are immediate with possible minimal downtime of 3-5 days required to achieve natural-looking results.

The benefits of a thread lift, it's a low-risk procedure, so most adults can have it.

Customer Testimonial:

The thread has the lifting capacity to elevate saggy areas including saggy jowl, jawline, deep laughing lines, and marionette lines.

Credits to Ava Skin

This thread lift is performed under local anesthesia, so the patient does not feel any pain during the procedure.

The ideal candidate's age is between 30 and 60 years old, and the amount of thread is determined during the consultation to see what the patient's main concerns are.

Thus, they're best suited for rejuvenating your skin while some newer types of thread lifts are better at lifting sagging skin.

Contact AVA Clinic to know more.

items.title: A FUN-FILLED, FAMILY TIME AT PETROSAINS!
items.content:
Credits to Petrosains

A visit to Petrosains, The Discovery Centre, is a must, as it promises a thrilling time filled with immersive learning experiences to spark wonder and curiosity in the world of science and technology.

Located in Suria KLCC, Kuala Lumpur City Centre, the interactive center hosting over 290 exhibits sets the perfect atmosphere for visitors from all walks of life to explore and appreciate the value of science as a fundamental necessity in everyday life.

Credits to Petrosains

Visit our themed galleries - Space, a place to discover the wonders of astronomy; Geotime Diorama, where you can learn and understand life on Earth during pre-historic times; and Sparks, an introduction to basic science concepts using a hands-on approach.

Other exhibition areas are The Platform, a true-to-life experience on an offshore oil rig, and SPEED! - which delves into the world of science behind racing.

Meanwhile, at the Maker Studio, get inspired by the chance to test your creativity as science communicators facilitate the creation and tinkering process among our guests.

There are also age-appropriate live science shows and workshops to spark curiosity among our young people about the world around us.

Credits to Petrosains

In a recent upgrade to inculcate the importance of adopting sustainable lifestyle practices as humanity progresses, Petrosains launched the Energy Capsule, an autonomous ride featuring light and music experiences, and multimedia elements that journey "back in time and into the future".

Cozy up in the 10-minute ride for a better understanding of the new energy story and the next technological revolution needed to deal with current, real-world issues and future challenges.

Credits to Petrosains

Aligned to the preservation of nature and our environment, the Sustainability Gallery aims to educate and empower people everywhere to think about the 'future we choose'. 

This showcase features content on significant issues, including ways to measure and reduce greenhouse gas emissions, exploration of new energy options, and integrated solutions to the global energy demand.

Credits to Petrosains

So come over, and dive into the fun world of science at Petrosains, The Discovery Centre today as we celebrate 25 years of inspiring discovery!

items.title: PETRONAS TWIN TOWERS: A SPECTACULAR SKYLINE ADVENTURE
items.content:
Credits to PETRONAS Twin Towers

Welcome to Kuala Lumpur, the vibrant capital of Malaysia, where remarkable transformations have taken place.

This city proudly showcases its crown jewel - the magnificent PETRONAS Twin Towers.

Standing tall at a height of 452 meters, these resilient, and progressive twin structures designed by the renowned architect Cesar Pelli symbolize the city's economic growth and embody the aspirations of our nation.

Immerse yourself in the architectural marvel, embrace the cultural heritage, and witness the city's vibrant skyline from extraordinary heights.

Step into the foyer at the entrance of the halls, and you'll be greeted by designs and patterns inspired by Malaysia's traditional handicrafts and weavings.

The wall panels and screens pay homage to the intricate hardwood carvings from the East Coast of Peninsular Malaysia, while the floor designs showcase the beauty of 'pandan' weavings and 'bertam' palm wall mattings.

The PETRONAS Twin Towers' design incorporates Islamic geometric forms known as Rub El Hizb, resulting in captivating eight-pointed star-shaped floor plates that embody the principles of unity, harmony, stability, and rationality adding a touch of cultural heritage.

Prepare to be mesmerized by panoramic views that stretch as far as the eye can see when you go on PETRONAS Twin Towers' exclusive tour packages.

The Symphony Tour grants you behind-the-scenes access to the prestigious Dewan Filharmonik PETRONAS, where you can witness the rehearsal sessions of a world-class symphony orchestra.

Credits to PETRONAS Twin Towers

Alternatively, the VIP Visit offers an extensive briefing about the towers, followed by a guided tour of the Skybridge and the Observation Deck.

With special arrangements for reserved parking and dedicated lift services, this package ensures a seamless and exclusive visit, enhancing the overall experience.

The guided tour, spanning approximately 45 minutes, begins at the Skybridge on the 41st Floor, a breathtaking structure suspended 170 meters above the bustling city streets.

But that's just the beginning. On the 83rd floor, delve deeper into the story of the Twin Towers as digital displays and informative videos provide further insights into their design and significance.

Explore the architectural masterpiece through interactive Augmented Reality (AR) screens and scale models, to gain a deeper understanding of its grandeur.

Credits to PETRONAS Twin Towers

As the tour continues upward, you'll reach the Observation Deck on the 86th Floor, where a mesmerizing panoramic view of the city skyline awaits.

Beyond its grandeur, the PETRONAS Twin Towers exemplify a commitment to sustainability.

With a significant 21.6% reduction in carbon emissions compared to 2019 levels, these towers stand as a beacon of environmental consciousness.

Additionally, the office of the Twin Towers successfully recycled a remarkable 3,692 kilograms of waste in 2022, showcasing their dedication to responsible practices.

Credits to PETRONAS Twin Towers

To conclude your visit, make sure to visit the PETRONAS Twin Towers' Gift Shop for a selection of memorable souvenirs to commemorate your extraordinary experience.


Address: Lower Ground (Concourse Level), PETRONAS Twin Towers, Kuala Lumpur City Centre, 50088 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Contact: +603-2331 8080
Website: https://www.petronastwintowers.com.my/
Visiting Hours: 9.00 am - 9.00 pm (Last admission at 8.30 pm) / Closed on Mondays, Hari Raya Aidilfitri and Aidiladha. / (Except Public Holidays or Replacement Public Holidays on Monday)

items.title: VISIT MORE THAN 100 CROCODILES AT TAMAN BUAYA MELAKA
items.content:
Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

Discover the Melaka Crocodile & Recreational Park, a beloved destination also known as Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka, which has been captivating visitors since July 1987.

Located in Ayer Keroh, it stands out as the premier attraction when exploring Melaka. 

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

Home to over 100 crocodiles spanning four species and a diverse array of animals.

You are able to see a variety of alligators and crocodiles here, including a sizable American alligator, a caiman with stripes, and a pale Indian marsh mugger crocodile.

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

The highlight of your visit is the chance to witness crocodile feedings conducted by the skilled keepers.

You might have a chance to give them food too!

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

Take a stroll around the park to observe crocodiles of different sizes in their natural habitat.

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

When you are at the park, you will get to see many crocodiles open their jaws wide, a behavior to regulate body temperature and prevent overheating through mouth evaporation.

This is a great way for the children to gain more knowledge about crocodiles as well as other animals at the park. 

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

The park isn't just about crocodiles; it boasts a Reptile House, a Mammals House, and a Walkthrough Aviary, showcasing a diverse range of animals such as rabbits, deer, birds, and snakes. 

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

Visitors can interact and feed some of these animals, although food must be purchased at the entrance counter.

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

Catch the opportunity to watch entertaining shows scheduled at 11.00 AM and 3.00 PM, featuring Edu Talk Snake, Magic Show, Crocodile with Humans, and Crocodile Feeding Demonstration.

Credits to Taman Buaya & Rekreasi Melaka Facebook

Don't forget to explore the Water Playground as well, providing a delightful space for swimming and recreational activities for families. 

For an unforgettable adventure with your loved ones, seize the opportunity to meet the cute animals at Crocodile Park Melaka.

items.content:

If you're up for some next-level thrills and spills in Kuala Lumpur, Bomb Battle is your best bet.

Credits to Bomb Battle

At Bomb Battle, you and your friends can experience the action with 5 thrilling live video game missions.

It's a test of teamwork and strategy as you work together to complete various tasks, from dodging lasers to cracking memory codes.

But the ultimate challenge lies in defusing the ticking paint bomb.

Credits to Bomb Battle

Fail to do so, and get ready to be blasted with paint!

Groups of 4-8 players will tackle a thrilling 75-minute mission named City Threat, with 5 battles, namely Power Grid, Laser Maze, Melody Hack, Decrypt It & Circuit Cracker.

Credits to Bomb Battle

Before the mission starts, you'll suit up in hazmat suits and protective gear, adding an extra layer of excitement and immersion to your experience.

So give it your all to extend your gameplay and increase your chances of success.

Credits to Bomb Battle

But even if you get blasted, don't fret! You'll receive a free bomb video to cherish the memories or share them on your social media for all your friends and followers to see.

At Bomb Battle, you have three exciting packages to choose from: the Bomb Mission, VIP Mission, and Premium Mission.

Credits to Bomb Battle

What sets them apart is the amount of paint bomb splash you'll experience.

In the VIP Mission, you'll also receive a Limited Edition Seasonal T-shirt and a refreshing Haus Boom welcome drink.

And if you opt for the Premium Mission, you'll enjoy a Limited Edition Seasonal T-shirt, two Haus Boom welcome drinks, and a stylish fashionable swag bag.

Credits to Bomb Battle

But the fun doesn't stop there!

Purchase 4 VIP tickets, and you'll receive a free XL water gun to make your experience even more exciting.

Credits to Bomb Battle

So, gather your friends and family and head over to Bomb Battle for unforgettable fun with the ultimate paint splash!

Bomb Battle now operates in 2 locations, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia and Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.

The primary goal is to promote good health, rather than fight disease.

Some of the treatments offered at the centre include Panchakarma, Abhayangam, Shirodhara, Njavara Kizhi, Takradhara, Udwarthanam (Weight Reduction Treatment), Kati Vasti, Januvasti, Thalapothichil, Mukha Lepam (Ayurvedic Facial), Siro Lepam (Ayurvedic Hair Care), and Nasyam.

When modern medicine falls short, Ayur Centre provides an essential alternative.

Traditional medicine, deeply rooted in Ayurveda, offers hope and healing for various ailments caused by our modern lifestyle.

Your journey to wellness begins at the Ayur Centre!

items.title: HOW TO GET TO FARM IN THE CITY KL AND BENTONG
items.content:
Credits to The Bentong Farm

Escape the hustle and bustle of the city and have a nature getaway where you can meet and pet adorable farm animals.

Farm In The City offers a remarkable experience that bridges the gap between urban living and rural charm.

This enchanting destination transports you to a world of greenery, fresh air, and the heartwarming company of farm animals.

Credits to The Bentong Farm

Prepare to be greeted by furry, feathered, and friendly animals as you step foot inside the farm!

From fluffy bunnies and quirky guinea pigs to friendly goats and graceful swans, the variety of animals here is truly astounding.

Credits to The Bentong Farm

Farm In The City KL is just 30 minutes from the center of Kuala Lumpur.

You can also use public transport to reach Farm In The City from KL City.

However, Farm In The City Bentong will take a 1-hour drive to reach the farm from Kuala Lumpur.

Credits to The Bentong Farm

KL The Guide is here to show you the way on how to get there:

GOING TO FARM IN THE CITY KL BY TRAIN

Taking the train, specifically the MRT, is the easiest way to Farm In The City KL, located in Seri Kembangan. 

Take the MRT Putrajaya Line and get off at the Putra Permai MRT station. 

Then, you have to walk 480m for 6 minutes from the MRT station to reach Farm In The City. 

GOING TO THE BENTONG FARM BY BUS

Credits to The Bentong Farm

The Bentong Farm is just an hour's drive from Kuala Lumpur city.

Take the bus from KL to Bentong at Pudu Sentral or Terminal Bersepadu Selatan (TBS).

Then, from Bentong town, take a taxi or use any e-hailing service to The Bentong Farm for about 10 minutes to reach the destination.

Credits to The Bentong Farm

Meet and pet with over 100 species of cute animals at Farm In The City KL and The Bentong Farm with your family and friends during the weekends to unwind amidst nature!

items.title: DISCOVER DELECTABLE SPANISH AND MEDITERRANEAN DELIGHTS AT EL IBERICO
items.content:
Credits to El Iberico

El Iberico is a welcoming restaurant nestled in the heart of Kuala Lumpur.

At El Iberico, you'll find a relaxed atmosphere where you can savor a diverse range of dishes, including their famous Iberico ribs, all served with a Mediterranean flair.

In this delightful Mediterranean setting, guests are invited to embark on a culinary journey that starts with a mix of mouthwatering dishes before exploring an extensive selection of wines, beers, and cocktails.

With its prime location, El Iberico promises to create unforgettable dining memories for you and your companions.

Now, let's take a closer look at some of the must-try dishes at El Iberico:

1. Gambas al Ajillo

Credits to El Iberico

If you're looking for the perfect appetizer, start with Gambas al Ajillo, a classic Spanish dish featuring succulent shrimp sauteed in garlic-infused olive oil.

2. El Iberico Escalivada

Credits to El Iberico

Enjoy a chargrilled vegetable salad, served cool with olive oil.

This Catalan specialty pairs wonderfully with roast meats or as a topping for crusty bread.

3. El Iberico Porchetta

Credits to El Iberico

Delight in the crispy perfection of a pork roast served with flavorful vegetables.

4. El Iberico Original Ribs

Credits to El Iberico

Indulge in Original Iberian Pork Spare Ribs, complemented by mashed potatoes and Oriental BBQ sauce.

You'll savor a medley of herbs, spices, beer, and honey with every bite.

5. Beef Wellington

Credits to El Iberico

items.title: HOW TO GET TO AL-AMAR LEBANESE CUISINE USING PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION
items.content:
Credits to Al-Amar Lebanese Cuisine

Have a hearty meal at Al-Amar in the heart of Kuala Lumpur!

AL-AMAR is the perfect one-stop destination if you would like to savor the essence of the Middle East specifically Lebanon.

Al-Amar is quite easy to get to as both Al-Amar and Al-Amar Express are ideally situated in Bukit Bintang.

Credits to Al-Amar Lebanese Cuisine

Both of their outlets are located in Bukit Bintang which is in Pavilion and Fahrenheit respectively.


It is accessible by public transport especially if you are a public transport user, hence here are some ways to get there.

Credits to Al-Amar Lebanese Cuisine

BY TRAIN

If you are using the monorail, get off at the Bukit Bintang Monorail station (exit at Lot 10) and take an approximate 4-minute and 7-minute walk to Al-Amar Express at Fahrenheit88 and Al-Amar at Pavilion KL respectively. 

For those using the MRT, get off at the Bukit Bintang MRT station and exit from either Exit D or Exit E. Then, take a 3-minute and 5-minute walk to Al-Amar Express Fahrenheit88 and Al-Amar at Pavilion KL respectively. 

BY BUS

Al Amar Lebanese Cuisine is also accessible via RapidKL Bus. 

Head over to the Pasar Seni Bus Hub and board the GOKL-02-(PURPLE) bus.

If you are from KLCC, board the RapidKL Bus GO-KL-01-(GREEN).

Then, by using either of these two buses, stop at Bintang Walk and you might have to walk 160m for 2 minutes until you reach Pavilion KL.

items.title: EXPLORING MALAYSIA'S PREMIER EXHIBITION HALLS WITH #TEAMDOREMI
items.content:
Check out Malaysia's top exhibition venues, showcasing how innovation, culture, and practicality combine to create memorable experiences.

Let's explore the top exhibition halls both within and beyond Kuala Lumpur, discovering how these venues set the stage for remarkable events.

Malaysia's Exhibition Halls: Showcases of Innovation and Diversity

1. Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre (KLCC): A modern, iconic venue in the heart of KL, ideal for large-scale international events.

2. MATRADE Exhibition and Convention Centre: Located in bustling Kuala Lumpur, offering various spaces tailored to different exhibitions.

3. MITEC - Malaysia International Trade and Exhibition Centre: One of Southeast Asia's largest venues, known for accommodating multiple exhibitions simultaneously.

4. Mid Valley Exhibition Centre: A unique venue within a vibrant shopping mall, favored for dynamic, interactive events.

5. WTC - World Trade Centre: Known for excellence and versatility, hosting a wide range of events due to its well-equipped rooms and central location.

Malaysia's Exhibition Gems: Beyond Kuala Lumpur's Borders

1. Setia SPICE Convention Centre, Penang: A vast venue in Penang with world-class facilities for exhibitions and conventions.

2. Borneo Convention Centre Kuching (BCCK), Sarawak: Nestled in Borneo's lush landscapes, offering a unique blend of nature and modernity for exhibitions.

3. Persada Johor International Convention Centre, Johor Bahru: A premier convention center with advanced technology and a central location, suitable for impactful events.

4. MAEPS - Malaysia Agro Exposition Park Serdang, Selangor: Known for its extensive outdoor spaces, providing a scenic backdrop for agriculture-related exhibitions.

5. Ipoh Convention Centre, Perak: Located in the heart of Perak, contributing to the state's prominence as an exhibition destination.

6. MAKSAK Malaysia Agro Exposition Park Serdang, Kelantan: An essential venue for agricultural shows in Kelantan, promoting agricultural interests.

7. Melaka International Trade Centre (MITC), Melaka: Known for its strategic location and well-designed spaces, playing a central role in Melaka's event landscape.

8. Sabah International Convention Centre (SICC), Kota Kinabalu: Strategically located in Kota Kinabalu, this versatile, multi-function complex with a stunning outdoor plaza is a premier waterfront venue for various events.

Beyond Spaces: Elevating Events with #TEAMDOREMi's Expertise

#TEAMDOREMi plays an important role in elevating the event experiences within Malaysia's premier exhibition halls. 

The focus is on the innovative and immersive solutions they provide for various events, both within and outside Kuala Lumpur.

An illuminating example is shown through the DCEU World of Exhibition, held at the Tropicana Gardens Mall, showcasing #TEAMDOREMi's meticulous attention to detail and their provision of cutting-edge equipment, including a lighting system, LCD TVs, and an AV system.

Defining Success: #TEAMDOREMi's Impactful Services

#TEAMDOREMi's success lies in its comprehensive event services, which enhance spaces into captivating event venues. These services include:

1. Lighting Brilliance: Creating captivating atmospheres through skillful lighting design, aligning with the event's theme.

2. Stage Excellence: Building stages that grab attention and reinforce the event's message, ensuring smooth event execution.

3. Audio-Visual Enchantment: Leveraging advanced audio and video technology to immerse attendees in captivating experiences.

4. Immersive Interactivity: Utilizing technologies like augmented reality and interactive screens to engage event attendees.


This article concludes by stressing that the success of an event goes beyond the physical space and depends on the creativity and innovation brought by #TEAMDOREMi.

They are capable of elevating MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) events to the next level, making sure every moment leaves a lasting impact.

items.title: EXPLORING IRRESISTABLE SWEET DELIGHTS WITH MADAM KWAN'S DESSERT MENU
items.content:
Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Calling all food enthusiasts with a love for sweet treats!

If you are in Malaysia, specifically in Kuala Lumpur or Klang Valley area, it is definitely a must to visit Madam Kwan's.

While this renowned restaurant is celebrated for its delectable Malaysian dishes, we're shining the spotlight on the dessert menu.

Madam Kwan's dessert selection is a realm of sweet enchantment, offering a delightful journey through Malaysia's diverse and rich dessert culture.

Let's explore some of the scrumptious desserts that will satisfy your sweet cravings.


1. Snowy Teh Tarik

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Prepare to be amazed by this unique Malaysian dessert.

The Snowy Teh Tarik is a milk tea-flavored shaved ice dessert, topped with chewy boba pearls.

It's a refreshing and playful twist on the classic Teh Tarik, perfect for those hot days in Kuala Lumpur. 

2. Cendol

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Cendol lovers, get ready for a special treat of the Musang King Durian Cendol.

Indulge in a delightful blend of coconut milk, sweet palm sugar, and fragrant durian.

3. Sagu Gula Melaka

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Savor the flavors of Sagu Gula Melaka, a classic Malaysian dessert.

Tapioca pearls are drenched in rich and aromatic palm sugar syrup, creating a sweet and satisfying treat that's beloved by the locals. 

4. Bubur Cha Cha

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Experience the comforting warmth of Bubur Cha Cha, a coconut milk-based dessert with colorful treasures like sweet potatoes and taro.

5. Banana Fritters with Ice Cream

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Indulge in the perfect combination of crispy banana fritters paired with two scoops of creamy ice cream; the perfect combination among the two different textures and temperatures.

6. Ice Campur

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Ice Campur is a delightful mix of various ingredients like palm sugar syrup, rose syrup, and evaporated milk topped with jelly, palm seeds, red beans, peanuts, cendol jelly, and sweet corn. 

7. Red Bean Ice

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

Shaved ice is served with red bean, coconut milk, and palm sugar syrup, creating a soothing dessert that's loved by Malaysians of all ages. 

8. Classic Banana Split


Credits to Madam Kwan's 

For a taste of nostalgia, indulge in the Classic Banana Split - a delightful combination of ripe bananas, ice cream, chocolate sauce, and nuts.

9. Ice Cream

Madam Kwan's also offers a selection of classic ice cream flavors, perfect for those who appreciate the simplicity of a scoop or two of their favorite creamy treat. 

10. Fresh Fruit Platter

Credits to Madam Kwan's 

For a lighter and healthier option, the Fresh Fruit Platter is a colorful assortment of seasonal fruits, beautifully presented to satisfy your sweet tooth. 


Madam Kwan's is a dessert lover's paradise, offering a diverse array of Malaysian sweet delights that are sure to leave a lasting impression.

The next time you are thinking of where to eat, be sure to head over to Madam Kwan's and save some room for their desserts!

items.title: EXPLORING THE FUTURE OF WELLNESS, CULTURE AND TOURISM: GWCTC2023
items.content:
Over 1,000 experts from the wellness, culture, travel, and tourism industries from around the world will gather at Royale Chulan Kuala Lumpur from Oct 26 to Oct 28 for the Global Wellness, Cultural, and Tourism Convention 2023 (GWCTC2023).


Organized by Confexhub Group in partnership with China (Sanya) Public Diplomacy Institute (SPDI), Asean-China Commerce Association, and Persatuan Kerjasama Ekonomi dan Perdagangan Antarabangsa; supported by Tourism Malaysia and The National Department for Culture and Arts will attract a large number of delegates from China.

GWCTC2023 holds a unique position as a catalyst for global industry transformation.


With the theme 'Unveiling Wellness, Cultural, and Tourism Destinations of Tomorrow', the convention aims to explore innovative strategies, unveil innovative solutions, and harness emerging technologies to shape a future where wellness, cultural preservation, and sustainable tourism are paramount. 


A range of exciting events is to be expected during the Global Wellness, Cultural and Tourism 2023 convention, including a welcome and networking reception to forge meaningful collaborations in a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, a high-caliber conference where industry experts, thought leaders and renowned speakers to share their insights, expertise, and experience; a gala dinner with signature cultural exchange, an international exhibition, technical presentation by China enterprises and a cultural study tour to Malacca.


Highlights from the upcoming convention include technical presentations by leading enterprises from China that will provide insights into innovative practices, cultural preservation, and wellness solutions.


Additionally, there will also be a two-day free exhibition showcasing the latest products, services, technologies, solutions, and innovations within the wellness, culture, travel, and tourism sectors.


On top of that, admission to the exhibition is free with registration.

For more information about GWCTC2023, visit www.gwctc.org

items.title: ENJOY DELECTABLE MALAYSIAN CUISINES AT MADAM KWAN'S
items.content:
Credits to Madam Kwan's

Madam Kwan is one of the best places to eat when you are craving some delicious Malaysian delights.

You are able to savor various local favorite dishes available at Madam Kwan's in Kuala Lumpur and throughout Klang Valley.

Credits to Madam Kwan's

There are no regional restrictions on the food at Madam Kwan's as it is a synthesis of the best elements from numerous communities, which are Penang, Melaka, Portuguese, or Malay. 


Besides that, all of the dishes that they serve at Madam Kwan's consists of family-friendly meals; perfect for everyone to enjoy!

Credits to Madam Kwan's

Madam Kwan can honestly claim to provide various delectable cuisine from all over Malaysia.

Credits to Madam Kwan's

Madam Kwan, also known as Kwan Swee Lian, acknowledges that she did not enjoy cooking when she initially entered the culinary industry in 1977, but she eventually learned to do so by making the same dish over and over again until she got it just perfect.

Due to the insistence on certain cooking techniques, which Madam Kwan developed via her cooking trails, the food served at Madam Kwan's outlets has a distinctive flavor.

Credits to Madam Kwan's

The iconic version of nasi lemak served at Madam Kwan's is one of the signature dishes there!

Credits to Madam Kwan's

Coconut-steamed rice, flavourful chicken curry, dried shrimp floss, Acar, sambal ikan bilis, hard-boiled egg, and cucumber slices are all ingredients in Madam Kwan's iconic Nasi Lemak. 

Credits to Madam Kwan's

Also available with the iconic nasi lemak is the tender beef rendang.

Madam Kwan uses a special combination of spices to provide flavor and attention to detail to the chicken curry. 

Credits to Madam Kwan's

Besides, there is also a variety of vegetarian dishes to choose from, especially for those who are vegetarians.

Credits to Madam Kwan's

On top of that, various Malaysian desserts are available for you to savor at Madam Kwan's as well.

Today, Madam Kwan's has a total of 16 outlets all over Malaysia, including beyond Klang Valley such as in Genting, Johor, and Sabah.

items.title: SATISFY BOTH YOUR HUNGER AND ALCOHOLIC NEEDS WITH GUINNESS-INFUSED DISHES AT ARTHUR'S STOREHOUSE
items.content:
Have you been wanting to have a culinary experience unlike any other in the heart of KL?

Look no further than ARTHUR'S STOREHOUSE!

Arthur's Storehouse is the best place to hang out with your friends for some Guinness drinks as well as savor some delicious Guinness-infused food.

Arthur's Storehouse provides various unique dishes on its menu, including its special Guinness-infused dishes. 


The flavors in the Guinness should be powerful and complex, giving the dishes a more unique flavor, acid, and some sugar. 

Apart from that, there are some dishes that KL The Guide recommends you try at Arthur's Storehouse.

For starters, KL The Guide recommends you try out the Guinness Battered Onion Rings. 

The onion rings are crispy and you get to taste a hint of the Guinness taste as you take your first bite. 

Next is the Bulldog Hokkien Mee where you can interchange between mee, mee hoon, or you can also mix both. 

The Hokkien Mee tastes just like the iconic dish from any hawker stall in Malaysia but with a mild taste of Guinness.

There is also a platter called the Grilled Oink Platter with a big tray of everything in it like the Chorizo coil sausage, pork neck, smoked pancetta, lagrimas, and pork chop with a side of salad and beer gravy - which is meant to be shared among three to four people. 

The Guinness Irish Beef Stew is served with Guinness Bread as the side and it is best to be paired with the Guinnesstini.

If you are going to consume Guinness-infused dishes (which clearly contain alcohol), don't assume that it won't affect you!

Similar to consuming alcohol, the Guinness-infused dishes have the potential to make you drunk!

For drinks, the Guinnesstini (served in a martini glass) consists of Guinness Foreign Extra Stout, Espresso, Vodka, Kahlua, and ice cream! 

The Guinness Milkshake is perfectly mixed with Guinness Draught and vanilla ice cream.

Don't forget to get a Stoutie, which is a specially printed selfie on your mug of Guinness Draught by using their special Guinness beer printer. 

Last but not least, try out Arthur's Storehouse's Guinness Piccolo.

A freshly roasted coffee with espresso Guinness draught served in a piccolo glass and topped to the brim with steamed milk in the style of a latte. 

Satisfy both your hunger and your alcoholic needs as you pig out on some of the best Guinness-infused dishes at Arthur's Storehouse!

items.title: TRAVEL WITH PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION IN KL, IS IT CONVENIENT?
items.content:
Credits to New Straits Times

Are you stressed about being stuck in traffic and having to experience road rage while driving?

By using public transport, you get to relax and just wait until you reach your desired destination. 

We recommend you use public transport because it is very affordable and reliable in Malaysia.

Most importantly, it is environmentally friendly as well.

When you use public transportation, you save money and avoid being stuck in traffic. 

It's preferable to use public transportation rather than e-hailing services because the fare could be very expensive during peak hours.

Credits to MyRapid.com.my

You could refer to the map above for your guide on traveling using public transportation in KL and Klang Valley, especially for LRT, MRT, KL Monorail, and Sunway BRT. 

When the lines intersect with each other, that is where you can interchange stations to get to your destination.

Credits to MyRapid.com.my

In order to travel using the LRT and MRT, you could use your TouchNGo card or any store card that has a TouchNGo feature.

Credits to MyRapid.com.my

You just have to top-up at any station's kiosk or you could purchase single-ride tickets at their designated kiosk or ticket counters that are available at any train station.

Credits to MyRapid.com.my

For those who are using the bus, you are required to use your TouchNGo card because buses do not accept cash payments anymore.

Credits to MyRapid.com.my

For your information, you are able to purchase the RapidKL monthly pass, MY50 which allows you to have unlimited travel for 30 days for just RM50 per month. 

This is available for LRT, MRT, KL Monorail, Sunway BRT, and also any RapidKL bus; it is not applicable to any KTM rides.

Credits to RapidKL Facebook

You may also plan your trip beforehand by using the phone application called PULSE by MyRapid.

It is catered to public transport users.

The app provides a complete guide on how to get to your destination by using public transportation.

You just have to insert your desired destination and then it tracks your current location using your GPS.

Then, it shows you the nearest station and how you could get there.

For the nearest bus station, it shows you the bus number and their estimated time of arrival.

In addition, if you are relying fully on public transportation and commute every day to work or school, it is best for you to use the app.


Therefore, traveling by public transport IS convenient because you get to avoid being stuck in traffic AND save money at the same time!

items.title: 5 DATING LOCATIONS IN KL THAT YOU CAN BRING YOUR PARTNER
items.content:
Credits to MarieFranceAsia

To our fellow readers, do you have a partner and are in need of date ideas?

We are here to help!

There are countless dating locations in Kuala Lumpur to go on a date with your partner.

Therefore, we have prepared a list of the best dating locations where you can bring your partner on your next date.


1. BUKIT ANTARABANGSA

Credits to JomJalan

Bukit Antarabangsa is located on a hillside in Ampang District's Ulu Klang, and it is of the locations to have a mesmerizing view of the sunset in KL with your loved ones.

You are able to look at the beautiful KL skyline while having a picnic there.

The best time to go there is at 6PM and find the perfect spot to settle down while waiting for the sunset because there might be quite a lot of people. 

It is open to the public with no entrance fee.

So what are you waiting for?

Go and bring your partner for a picnic date with a beautiful sunset view of KL!


2. PETROSAINS

Credits to Petrosains Facebook

Petrosains is located in KLCC and this is definitely a place for you to have a fun date experience with your partner especially if they love science!

Petrosains is where you can test your partner's knowledge of science as well.

Explore the world of science with tons of fun activities throughout the place while educating ourselves.

The entrance fee is only RM18.50 for MyKad adults, and it is considered one of the most affordable places for you to have a memorable date.


3. AQUARIA

Credits to Klook

Aquaria is where you can bring your partner to capture memories while you enjoy experiencing the marine life there.

There are various kinds of sea creatures for you to look at.

This is the perfect place to have a romantic yet fun date with your loved ones.

Although the entrance ticket for adults is quite costly, which is RM45 for MyKad holders, it is worth every penny.

Also, don't forget to take cute couple pictures while being 'under the sea'!


4. PASAR SENI / CENTRAL MARKET

There are a few activities that you could do at Pasar Seni besides shopping for arts and crafts.

The activities that you could do with your partner are batik painting and visiting the Illusion 3D Art Museum.

Credits to Central Market

The batik painting is at the back part of Pasar Seni called Ainna Artwork and this is where you get a batik design of your choice and paint it on your own together with your partner.

This would channel your inner creative side and show it to your partner!

Credits to Klook

Besides that, the Illusion 3D Art Museum is located on the second floor right above Ainna Artwork.

This is where you could get your mind blown with the illusions while taking fun pictures with them!


5. AURUM CINEMA

Credits to TheStar

Planning to go for a movie date with your partner?

Aurum Cinema is the place for you to take your partner on a movie date to another level!

It is GSC's latest theatre which is located in The Gardens Mall.

The seats in the cinema actually look like beds instead of seats and they are queen-sized beds.

They also provide blankets for you to snuggle down in your beds while you enjoy your movie.

The price is approximately RM160 per person including food and drinks.

You could purchase your tickets at their kiosk or at their online website as well.

items.title: GET UP CLOSE AND PERSONAL WITH CUTE ANIMALS AT FARM IN THE CITY
items.content:
FARM IN THE CITY combines elements of nature and wildlife in a carefully designed setting resembling a conservation park.

With inspiration from Malaysia's mixed and cosmopolitan population, Farm In The City was developed to resemble a typical Malaysian village or 'kampung' scene. 

This zoo houses a wide variety of animal species with more than 100 different tame and exotic animal species that can be interacted with here.

It mixes the thrills of wildlife with the beauty of nature by incorporating components of wildlife and nature into a designed habitat resembling a conservation park. 

Also, several animals are available for visitors to pet and feed!

The children will definitely enjoy themselves because they are able to meet and pet cute animals!

They will discover the value of protecting the environment and how it affects the lives of these lovely creatures.

There is also an orchard on the farm with a massive exhibition of more than 60 tropical fruit trees and exotic vegetation.

Other than that, there are more than 300 unique birds from various parts of the world are kept on this farm and some of them are flying freely around the farm.

Farm In The City has a main objective which is to inform and educate the public on the habitats, behavior, and geographic distribution of many species of animals.

On top of that, cages are completely absent on this farm as animals are allowed to roam free in special enclosures that have been created to closely replicate their natural habitats.

In addition to its role in the study and preservation of nature and wildlife, Farm In The City is slated to develop into a significant tourist destination for the state of Selangor. 

Visit this farm to gain a broader understanding of animal care and conservation!

items.content:
For those of you who are searching for a culinary experience like no other, look no further than Betty's Midwest Kitchen!

BETTY'S MIDWEST KITCHEN is a homey diner nestled amidst a quaint neighborhood in Aman Suria, PJ.   

Betty's Midwest Kitchen serves a variety of American dishes, particularly from the Midwest. 

They offer various unique dishes such as Maple Bacon Belly, Hot Honey Ribs, Grilled Beer Braised Boston Butt, and so on. 

This lovely American Midwest restaurant is run by a mother-and-son duo since 2008; they have been around for 15 years already!

When you think about American food, the first thing that comes to mind is how their food is known for being incredibly inventive and open-minded.

Uncovering why Betty's Midwest Kitchen's unique food tastes the way it does is based solely on the perfectly curated dishes made by the mother-and-son duo! 

They provide special menus once a week and their non-fixed specials will keep on changing every week.

This will make their customers eager to visit their restaurant and discover what they have in store each week. 

Everything on their menu is available any time of the day; only the weekly specials will change. 

Apart from that, their top signature dishes are baby back ribs, soft ribs, and sausages.

There is also a family platter with a big tray of everything in it like the baby back ribs, sausages, fries, and so on - which is meant to be shared among four to five people.

For their weekly specials, we have tried their Root Beer Ribs, House Cured Maple Bacon, and the Ham & Tomato Soup.

This Root Beer Rib tastes enticingly delicious with crispy skin and tender meat that is easy to cut. 

It is marinated to perfection and when you take your first bite, you can definitely taste the juiciness of the meat.

It is also served in a big portion and you might have to share it, especially if you're a light eater. 

As for their House Cured Maple Bacon, you can taste the sweetness of the maple syrup as well as the buttery and salty taste of the bacon.

The meat is marinated until perfection which is soft and tender, making it easy to be eaten as well.

This is the Pork Chop Country Gravy, with green peas and mashed potatoes on its sides.  

The pork chop meat is slightly dry but the country sauce gravy omits the taste of dryness and balances out the taste.

The mashed potato, however, is very tasty and creamy as you can taste the sweetness of the butter in it. 

This cheesy dish is called Dog Food and it is one of their iconic dishes. 

Their Dog Food dish is a delicious oven-cooked fries served in a pie dish that is drenched in creamy gravy and topped with cheese!

Their tagline, 'America On A Plate' gives off a great experience for Malaysians, who have never been to America, to get a taste of Midwest American dishes. 

Most of their regular customers enjoy coming to the restaurant because of its homely ambiance and food and it is perfect to dine in with their families.

Trying out American Midwest cuisine is quite an experience because you don't know what kind of unique dishes they have to offer. 

If you are hungry and are currently craving some unique American food, this is the best place to go!


Address: A-G-40, Jalan PJU 1/43, Aman Suria, 47301 Petaling Jaya, Selangor
Contact: +603-7880 0196
Website: https://www.midwestkitchen.com.my/
Operating Hours: 11.30 am - 3.00 pm, 5.30 pm - 9.45 pm (Tuesday-Sunday) / Closed on Monday

items.title: ENJOY SOME COLD SENSATION OF CENDOL AT CENDOL KAMPUNG HULU
items.content:
Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

 In need of some cold sensation during a scorching hot day?

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

Stop by CENDOL KAMPUNG HULU to enjoy some refreshing cendol.

Cendol is a shaved-iced sweet treat that includes palm sugar syrup, coconut milk, and specks of green rice flour jelly. 

This is one of the best places in Melaka to get cendol as they create their own product recipe along with a premium taste to it.

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

There are various other toppings that are available for your desired cendol as there are 10 types of cendol for you to choose from. 

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

Some of the toppings are durian, fermented sweet cassava (tapai), dragon fruit, mango, fruit cocktail, and so on.

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

One of their best-selling cendol is their cendol durian and it is a must-try cendol when you are there.

Enjoy the Malaysian King of Fruits that goes well with the cooling sensation of the tasty cendol!

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

Besides that, regular customers would visit their place frequently due to the unique mixture and combination of green cendol with pandan coconut ice cream, Melaka sugar, red beans, shaved ice, and especially with sliced tropical fruits. 

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

As you are having your delicious cendol, you are able to enjoy the view of the riverside and look at the Melaka river cruise making its way along the river. 

Credits to Cendol Kampung Hulu FB

The Cendol Kampung Hulu brand currently has 3 outlets, with locations in Melaka, Muar, and Johor Bahru. 

On top of that, their brand-new Port Dickson branch will open on February 18, 2023!



Address: Kampung Hulu, Melaka / Muar, Johor / B5 Johor Street Market, Johor
Contact: +6012-673 2028
Website: https://cendolkampunghulu.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cendolkampunghulu/
Operating Hours: 11.00 am - 11.00 pm (Monday-Sunday)
